en: The puppy had been abandoned in a box near our school gate.
zh: 那隻小狗被遺棄在我們校門附近的一個箱子裡。

en: Lisa has absolute trust in her best friend and tells her everything.
zh: 麗莎完全信任她最好的朋友，什麼事都跟她說。

en: Amy was so absorbed in her novel that she missed her bus stop.
zh: 艾咪看小說看得太入迷，結果坐過了站。

en: Happiness and freedom are abstract ideas, so they are difficult to explain to children.
zh: 快樂和自由是抽象的概念，所以很難向小孩解釋。

en: Our school library has many academic books for students who love science.
zh: 我們學校圖書館有許多學術書籍，供熱愛科學的學生閱讀。

en: Although Ken grew up abroad, he speaks Chinese without any accent at all.
zh: 雖然肯在國外長大，他說中文卻一點口音也沒有。

en: Getting a letter of acceptance from her dream university made Lisa cry with joy.
zh: 收到夢想大學的錄取信，讓麗莎喜極而泣。

en: Students can get access to the Internet in the library for free.
zh: 學生可以在圖書館免費使用網路。

en: The discovery was accidental; the scientist was actually looking for something else.
zh: 這項發現純屬意外；那位科學家其實是在找別的東西。

en: Amy's mother accompanied her to the hospital for her health check.
zh: 艾咪的媽媽陪她去醫院做健康檢查。

en: With help from her classmates, Mia accomplished the difficult science project in two weeks.
zh: 在同學的幫忙下，米亞在兩週內完成了那份困難的科學專題。

en: Her father is an accountant, so he is very good with numbers.
zh: 她爸爸是會計師，所以對數字很在行。

en: Kevin threw the ball with great accuracy and hit the center of the target.
zh: 凱文投球非常精準，正中靶心。

en: Lisa was upset when a classmate accused her of copying his homework.
zh: 一位同學指控麗莎抄他的作業，讓她很難過。

en: Lemon juice contains acid, so it tastes sour and can hurt your teeth.
zh: 檸檬汁含有酸，所以嚐起來酸酸的，還可能傷害牙齒。

en: Tom isn't really my friend; he's just an acquaintance from the tennis club.
zh: 湯姆其實不算是我的朋友，他只是網球社認識的人。

en: Living abroad for a year helped Amy acquire a new language quickly.
zh: 在國外住了一年，幫助艾咪很快學會了一種新語言。

en: It took the new student a few weeks to adapt to life in Taipei.
zh: 那位新同學花了幾個星期才適應台北的生活。

en: Ben is a game addict who plays on his phone until midnight every day.
zh: 班是個遊戲成癮者，每天都在手機上玩到半夜。

en: Teenagers need adequate sleep to stay healthy and focus in class.
zh: 青少年需要足夠的睡眠，才能保持健康並在課堂上專心。

en: It took Amy a week to adjust to her new school schedule.
zh: 艾咪花了一個星期才適應新學校的課表。

en: It was admirable of Kevin to return the wallet he found on the bus.
zh: 凱文把在公車上撿到的錢包歸還，真令人欽佩。

en: The students looked at the famous scientist with great admiration.
zh: 學生們以非常欽佩的眼神看著那位知名科學家。

en: Admission to the museum is free for students on weekends.
zh: 週末時學生可以免費進入博物館參觀。

en: The Wangs decided to adopt a little dog instead of buying one.
zh: 王家決定領養一隻小狗，而不是用買的。

en: We planned our class trip through a travel agency near the train station.
zh: 我們透過火車站附近的一家旅行社安排了班遊。

en: The young singer's agent helps her plan all her shows and interviews.
zh: 那位年輕歌手的經紀人幫她安排所有的表演和訪問。

en: That dog can be aggressive toward strangers, so please don't touch it.
zh: 那隻狗對陌生人可能會有攻擊性，所以請不要摸牠。

en: The weather was agreeable, so we decided to have a picnic by the river.
zh: 天氣很宜人，所以我們決定到河邊野餐。

en: Please clean your hands with alcohol before you enter the hospital room.
zh: 進入病房前，請先用酒精清潔雙手。

en: Drinking coffee in the morning helps Mia stay alert during her first class.
zh: 早上喝咖啡幫助米亞在第一節課保持清醒警覺。

en: Amy saves half of her weekly allowance to buy a new camera.
zh: 艾咪把每週零用錢存下一半，打算買一台新相機。

en: If it rains tomorrow, the alternative plan is to visit the science museum.
zh: 如果明天下雨，替代方案是去參觀科學博物館。

en: Although he is just an amateur, his photos are as good as an expert's.
zh: 雖然他只是個業餘愛好者，他拍的照片卻和專家一樣好。

en: The question on the test was ambiguous, so many students answered it differently.
zh: 考卷上那一題模稜兩可，所以很多學生的答案都不一樣。

en: Lisa is ambitious; she hopes to become a doctor and help people abroad.
zh: 麗莎很有抱負，她希望成為醫生並到國外幫助人們。

en: The clown's funny tricks amused the children at the hospital party.
zh: 小丑有趣的把戲逗樂了醫院派對上的孩子們。

en: The scientists' analysis of the water showed that it was safe to drink.
zh: 科學家對這些水的分析顯示，這水可以安全飲用。

en: In science class, we analyzed the data from our experiment in small groups.
zh: 在自然課上，我們分成小組分析實驗得到的數據。

en: Every New Year, Lisa's family prepares food and prays to their ancestors together.
zh: 每逢過年，麗莎一家人都會準備飯菜，一起祭拜祖先。

en: Our school will celebrate its fiftieth anniversary with a big concert in December.
zh: 我們學校將在十二月舉辦一場大型音樂會，慶祝五十週年校慶。

en: The loud music from the next room annoyed Amy while she was studying.
zh: 隔壁房間傳來的吵鬧音樂讓正在讀書的艾咪很煩。

en: Our school holds its annual sports day every November, and everyone joins in.
zh: 我們學校每年十一月舉辦年度運動會，每個人都會參加。

en: Many students feel anxiety before big exams, so deep breathing can help.
zh: 許多學生在大考前會感到焦慮，所以深呼吸會有幫助。

en: Ben offered his sister an apology for breaking her favorite cup.
zh: 班為了打破妹妹最喜歡的杯子而向她道歉。

en: It was apparent from her bright smile that Mia had passed the exam.
zh: 從米亞燦爛的笑容就能明顯看出她考試及格了。

en: Each applicant must explain in an interview why they want to join the club.
zh: 每位申請人都必須在面試中說明自己為什麼想加入這個社團。

en: Lisa filled out an application for a summer job at the café.
zh: 麗莎填了一份到咖啡館暑期打工的申請表。

en: Amy has a dentist appointment at four, so she will leave school early.
zh: 艾咪四點和牙醫有約，所以她會提早離開學校。

en: We gave our teacher a card to show our appreciation for her help.
zh: 我們送老師一張卡片，表達對她幫忙的感謝。

en: Shorts and slippers are not appropriate for a job interview.
zh: 短褲和拖鞋不適合穿去參加工作面試。

en: Students need their parents' approval to join the three-day school trip.
zh: 學生需要家長同意，才能參加為期三天的校外旅行。

en: The kids watched sharks and colorful fish swim at the aquarium.
zh: 孩子們在水族館看鯊魚和五顏六色的魚游來游去。

en: Hikers stopped to take photos under the huge stone arch by the sea.
zh: 登山客停下來，在海邊那座巨大的石拱門下拍照。

en: If any problems arise during the trip, please call your teacher at once.
zh: 旅途中如果出現任何問題，請立刻打電話給老師。

en: The history museum shows old arms such as swords used by soldiers long ago.
zh: 歷史博物館展示了很久以前士兵使用的刀劍等古老武器。

en: These flowers on the café table look real, but they are actually artificial.
zh: 咖啡館桌上的這些花看起來像真的，但其實是人造的。

en: Mia is very artistic; she designs all the posters for our school club.
zh: 米亞很有藝術天分，我們社團所有的海報都是她設計的。

en: Ben felt ashamed of himself for lying to his parents about his grades.
zh: 班因為對父母謊報成績而感到很羞愧。

en: Making friends is an important aspect of high school life.
zh: 交朋友是高中生活中很重要的一個方面。

en: Mom took an aspirin for her headache and lay down for a rest.
zh: 媽媽因為頭痛吃了一顆阿斯匹靈，然後躺下來休息。

en: It took Dad two hours to assemble the new desk for my room.
zh: 爸爸花了兩個小時才把我房間的新書桌組裝好。

en: The whole school gathered in the hall for the Monday morning assembly.
zh: 全校師生在禮堂集合，參加星期一早上的朝會。

en: Our English teacher gave us a reading assignment due next Friday.
zh: 英文老師出了一份閱讀作業，下週五要交。

en: If you need any assistance, please ask the staff at the information desk.
zh: 如果需要任何協助，請洽詢服務台的工作人員。

en: Many people associate the smell of rain with peaceful summer afternoons.
zh: 許多人會把雨的氣味和寧靜的夏日午後聯想在一起。

en: The student association plans fun events for new students every September.
zh: 學生會每年九月都會為新生規劃有趣的活動。

en: The coach gave us his assurance that everyone would get a chance to play.
zh: 教練向我們保證，每個人都會有上場的機會。

en: The doctor assured Amy that her leg would heal in a few weeks.
zh: 醫生向艾咪保證她的腿幾個星期就會好。

en: Kevin is very athletic and plays basketball, tennis, and volleyball.
zh: 凱文很有運動細胞，籃球、網球和排球都會打。

en: The café has a warm and relaxing atmosphere, perfect for studying with friends.
zh: 這家咖啡館的氣氛溫馨又放鬆，非常適合和朋友一起讀書。

en: Everything around us, even the air, is made up of tiny atoms.
zh: 我們周遭的一切，甚至連空氣，都是由微小的原子組成的。

en: In science class, we learned about the atomic structure of water.
zh: 在自然課上，我們學到了水的原子結構。

en: Please attach a recent photo of yourself to the club sign-up form.
zh: 請在社團報名表上附上一張你的近照。

en: Night markets are one of Taiwan's most popular attractions for visitors.
zh: 夜市是台灣最受遊客歡迎的景點之一。

en: The museum offers free audio guides in five different languages.
zh: 這間博物館提供五種語言的免費語音導覽。

en: Many visitors say this little shop sells the most authentic beef noodles in town.
zh: 許多遊客說這家小店賣的是城裡最道地的牛肉麵。

en: Only the principal has the authority to cancel classes because of a typhoon.
zh: 只有校長有權力因颱風宣布停課。

en: In her autobiography, the famous singer writes honestly about her difficult childhood.
zh: 在自傳中，那位知名歌手坦白地寫下她艱苦的童年。

en: Lisa waited for an hour to get her favorite writer's autograph.
zh: 麗莎等了一個小時，才拿到她最喜歡的作家的親筆簽名。

en: The students nervously await their exam results, which will come out next Monday.
zh: 學生們緊張地等待考試成績，成績下週一就會公布。

en: Grandpa went bald in his forties, but he says he likes his shiny head.
zh: 爺爺四十幾歲就禿頭了，但他說他很喜歡自己亮晶晶的頭。

en: Amy has taken ballet lessons since she was five years old.
zh: 艾咪從五歲起就開始上芭蕾舞課。

en: The nurse put a bandage on Ben's knee after he fell during the race.
zh: 班在賽跑時跌倒後，護理師在他的膝蓋上包了繃帶。

en: The small bookstore went bankrupt because fewer people bought paper books.
zh: 那家小書店因為買紙本書的人變少而破產了。

en: This jacket was a real bargain; I got it for half price.
zh: 這件夾克真是撿到便宜，我用半價就買到了。

en: Language can be a barrier when you travel to a foreign country.
zh: 到外國旅行時，語言可能會是一種障礙。

en: Mom filled a basin with warm water to wash the baby's feet.
zh: 媽媽在盆子裡裝了溫水，幫寶寶洗腳。

en: The battery of Mia's phone died in the middle of her video call.
zh: 米亞視訊通話到一半，手機電池就沒電了。

en: In the old story, a poor beggar becomes a rich man through hard work.
zh: 在那個古老的故事裡，一個貧窮的乞丐靠著努力成為富翁。

en: The teacher praised the class for their good behavior during the field trip.
zh: 老師稱讚全班在校外教學時表現良好。

en: Please throw your empty bottles into the bin by the classroom door.
zh: 請把空瓶子丟進教室門邊的垃圾桶。

en: For her book report, Lisa is reading a biography of a famous woman scientist.
zh: 為了寫讀書心得，麗莎正在讀一位知名女科學家的傳記。

en: In biology class, we learned how plants turn sunlight into food.
zh: 在生物課上，我們學到植物如何把陽光轉化成養分。

en: Be careful with the knife because its blade is very sharp.
zh: 小心那把刀，因為它的刀刃非常鋒利。

en: Blend the bananas with milk and ice to make a healthy drink.
zh: 把香蕉和牛奶、冰塊一起打勻，就能做出一杯健康飲品。

en: Having a family that supports my dreams is a real blessing.
zh: 有一個支持我夢想的家庭，真是一種福氣。

en: The little baby blinked when the bright light was turned on.
zh: 明亮的燈一打開，小寶寶就眨了眨眼。

en: The cherry trees in the park bloom every spring, attracting many visitors.
zh: 公園裡的櫻花樹每年春天開花，吸引許多遊客。

en: We had a picnic under the pink cherry blossoms on Sunday afternoon.
zh: 星期天下午，我們在粉紅色的櫻花下野餐。

en: Ken often boasts about his test scores, so some classmates find him rude.
zh: 肯常常炫耀自己的考試分數，所以有些同學覺得他很沒禮貌。

en: Playing in the band together created a strong bond between the four girls.
zh: 一起在樂團演奏，讓這四個女孩之間建立了深厚的情誼。

en: The ball bounced off the wall and rolled under the teacher's desk.
zh: 球從牆上彈開，滾到了老師的桌子底下。

en: Amy made a colorful bracelet for her best friend's birthday.
zh: 艾咪為最好朋友的生日做了一條色彩繽紛的手環。

en: Which breed of dog is best for a family with small children?
zh: 哪一種品種的狗最適合有小孩的家庭？

en: At my cousin's wedding, the bridegroom gave a funny and touching speech.
zh: 在我表姊的婚禮上，新郎發表了一段既有趣又感人的致詞。

en: After buying concert tickets, Lisa was broke until the end of the month.
zh: 買了演唱會門票之後，麗莎到月底前都身無分文。

en: After the party, we used a broom to sweep the classroom floor.
zh: 派對結束後，我們用掃帚清掃教室地板。

en: The summer heat this year has been brutal, so stay inside at noon.
zh: 今年夏天的酷熱非常嚴酷，所以中午請待在室內。

en: The exam schedule is posted on the bulletin board outside the office.
zh: 考試時間表貼在辦公室外面的公告欄上。

en: A burglar broke into our neighbor's house while they were on vacation.
zh: 鄰居去度假時，有竊賊闖進了他們家。

en: Mom keeps the medicine in a small cabinet in the bathroom.
zh: 媽媽把藥放在浴室裡的一個小櫥櫃中。

en: Use your phone to calculate how much each person should pay for dinner.
zh: 用你的手機算一算晚餐每個人該付多少錢。

en: A quick calculation shows that we need three more chairs for the guests.
zh: 快速算一下就知道，我們還需要三張椅子給客人坐。

en: A cup of bubble tea can have more than five hundred calories.
zh: 一杯珍珠奶茶的熱量可能超過五百卡路里。

en: Our school started a campaign to reduce plastic waste in the cafeteria.
zh: 我們學校發起了一項活動，要減少學生餐廳的塑膠垃圾。

en: Three candidates hope to become class leader, so we will vote tomorrow.
zh: 有三位候選人想當班長，所以我們明天要投票。

en: Grandpa needs a cane to walk because his knees hurt.
zh: 爺爺的膝蓋會痛，所以他需要拄手杖走路。

en: We took turns rowing a canoe on the quiet lake at summer camp.
zh: 夏令營時，我們輪流在平靜的湖上划獨木舟。

en: The concert hall has a capacity of two thousand people.
zh: 這座音樂廳可容納兩千人。

en: Taipei, the capital of Taiwan, is famous for its night markets and friendly people.
zh: 台灣的首都台北，以夜市和友善的人們聞名。

en: The rich capitalist used part of his money to build schools in poor areas.
zh: 那位富有的資本家拿出部分財產，在貧窮地區蓋學校。

en: The ship carried cargo such as fruit and machines to other countries.
zh: 這艘船載運水果和機器等貨物到其他國家。

en: Mosquitoes are carriers of some serious diseases, so protect yourself when hiking.
zh: 蚊子是某些嚴重疾病的帶原者，所以健行時要保護好自己。

en: The artist carved a beautiful bird out of a single piece of wood.
zh: 那位藝術家用一整塊木頭雕刻出一隻美麗的鳥。

en: Mom looked through the store's catalogue to choose a new sofa.
zh: 媽媽翻閱這家店的商品目錄，挑選新沙發。

en: In the library, books are arranged by category, such as history and science.
zh: 圖書館裡的書依類別排列，例如歷史類和科學類。

en: The rain finally ceased, and the sun came out over the mountains.
zh: 雨終於停了，太陽從山的那一頭露了出來。

en: There was a big celebration at school after our basketball team won first place.
zh: 我們的籃球隊得到第一名後，學校舉行了盛大的慶祝活動。

en: The tour guide led us into a dark chamber deep inside the old castle.
zh: 導遊帶我們走進古老城堡深處的一個陰暗房間。

en: Our volleyball team won the city championship for the second year in a row.
zh: 我們的排球隊連續第二年贏得全市冠軍。

en: Kindness is one of Amy's best characteristics; she always helps others.
zh: 善良是艾咪最好的特質之一，她總是幫助別人。

en: The students sold cookies and gave all the money to charity.
zh: 學生們義賣餅乾，並把所有的錢捐給慈善機構。

en: Mia loves chemistry class because she enjoys mixing liquids and watching them change color.
zh: 米亞很喜歡化學課，因為她喜歡混合液體、看它們變色。

en: Lisa will always cherish the memories of her high school friends.
zh: 麗莎會永遠珍惜和高中朋友們的回憶。

en: Remember to chew your food slowly; it's better for your stomach.
zh: 記得慢慢咀嚼食物，這樣對胃比較好。

en: Cut the grapes in half so the little children won't choke on them.
zh: 把葡萄切成兩半，小朋友才不會被噎到。

en: Amy sings in the school chorus, and they practice every Tuesday after school.
zh: 艾咪參加學校合唱團，他們每週二放學後練習。

en: We sat around a circular table so everyone could see each other.
zh: 我們圍著一張圓桌坐，這樣每個人都能看到彼此。

en: Regular exercise helps blood circulate through your body and keeps your heart healthy.
zh: 規律運動有助於血液在全身循環，並保持心臟健康。

en: Sitting still for too long can lead to poor circulation in your legs.
zh: 坐著不動太久可能會導致腿部血液循環不良。

en: Under no circumstances should students use their phones during the exam.
zh: 無論在任何情況下，學生都不可以在考試時使用手機。

en: After the earthquake, soldiers and civilians worked together to clean up the town.
zh: 地震過後，軍人和平民一起合力清理城鎮。

en: The museum shows how ancient civilizations used the stars to make calendars.
zh: 博物館展示了古代文明如何利用星星來製作曆法。

en: Could you clarify what you mean by "teamwork" in your report?
zh: 你能不能說清楚你報告裡的「團隊合作」是什麼意思？

en: There was a clash between the two groups over how to spend the club money.
zh: 兩派人馬為了社費該怎麼花而起了衝突。

en: The classification of animals into groups helps scientists study them.
zh: 把動物分門別類，有助於科學家研究牠們。

en: In science class, we classified the leaves by their shape and size.
zh: 在自然課上，我們依照形狀和大小把樹葉分類。

en: Our cat used its sharp claws to tear holes in the new sofa.
zh: 我們家的貓用尖銳的爪子在新沙發上抓出了好幾個洞。

en: Stay away from the edge of the cliff; the rocks are loose.
zh: 離懸崖邊遠一點，那裡的石頭很鬆動。

en: Ben is so clumsy that he dropped his phone three times today.
zh: 班笨手笨腳的，今天已經把手機摔了三次。

en: This old towel feels coarse on my skin, so I prefer the soft one.
zh: 這條舊毛巾摸起來很粗糙，所以我比較喜歡那條柔軟的。

en: Enter the code on the door to get into the apartment building.
zh: 在門上輸入密碼，就能進入公寓大樓。

en: The old bridge collapsed during the strong typhoon, but no one was hurt.
zh: 那座老橋在強烈颱風中倒塌了，所幸沒有人受傷。

en: Dad often goes hiking with his colleagues from the office on weekends.
zh: 爸爸週末常和公司的同事一起去爬山。

en: The soup is a perfect combination of sweet and sour tastes.
zh: 這道湯是酸甜滋味的完美結合。

en: We watched a comedy last night and laughed until our stomachs hurt.
zh: 我們昨晚看了一部喜劇，笑到肚子都痛了。

en: The commander ordered his soldiers to help people after the flood.
zh: 指揮官命令他的士兵在水災後協助民眾。

en: Many people left kind comments under Amy's video about her pet rabbit.
zh: 許多人在艾咪介紹寵物兔的影片下留下了友善的評論。

en: Online commerce has changed the way people shop for clothes and food.
zh: 網路商業改變了人們購買衣服和食物的方式。

en: Lisa has committed herself to practicing the piano for an hour every day.
zh: 麗莎承諾自己每天要練一個小時的鋼琴。

en: Honest communication is the key to keeping a friendship strong and happy.
zh: 誠實的溝通是讓友誼穩固又快樂的關鍵。

en: The students offered to clean the park in their local community.
zh: 學生們主動提議打掃他們社區的公園。

en: Her dog has been her best companion for more than ten years.
zh: 她的狗十多年來一直是她最好的伴侶。

en: Amy won first prize in the English speech competition held in Taipei last month.
zh: 艾咪在上個月於台北舉行的英語演講比賽中得到第一名。

en: Getting into a top university is very competitive, so many students study late every night.
zh: 要進入頂尖大學競爭非常激烈，所以很多學生每晚都讀到很晚。

en: More than fifty competitors took part in the city running race this year.
zh: 今年有超過五十名參賽者參加了全市路跑比賽。

en: Don't complicate the problem; just tell your teacher what really happened.
zh: 別把問題弄得更複雜，直接告訴老師到底發生了什麼事就好。

en: Lisa composed a short song for her grandmother's eightieth birthday.
zh: 麗莎為奶奶的八十歲生日創作了一首短短的歌。

en: The young composer wrote the music for our school's new musical.
zh: 那位年輕的作曲家為我們學校的新音樂劇譜寫了音樂。

en: Our teacher asked us to write a composition about our summer vacation.
zh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於暑假的作文。

en: It's hard to concentrate on your homework when your phone keeps ringing.
zh: 手機一直響的時候，很難專心寫作業。

en: Doing puzzles every day can help improve your concentration and memory.
zh: 每天玩益智拼圖能幫助提升專注力和記憶力。

en: The teacher used a simple drawing to explain the concept of time zones.
zh: 老師用一張簡單的圖來解釋時區的概念。

en: Students had many questions concerning the new school uniform rules.
zh: 學生們對新的制服規定有許多疑問。

en: Can you give me a concrete example to explain your idea?
zh: 你能舉一個具體的例子來說明你的想法嗎？

en: The conductor raised her hands, and the school band began to play.
zh: 指揮舉起雙手，學校樂隊便開始演奏。

en: Our principal is attending an education conference in Tainan this week.
zh: 我們校長這星期在台南參加一場教育會議。

en: Ben finally confessed that he had eaten the last piece of cake.
zh: 班終於坦承最後一塊蛋糕是他吃掉的。

en: Practicing in front of a mirror gave Lisa more confidence before her speech.
zh: 在鏡子前練習，讓麗莎演講前更有信心。

en: There was some confusion about the time of the meeting, so few people came.
zh: 大家對開會時間有些混淆，所以來的人很少。

en: All her classmates congratulated Mia on getting into her dream school.
zh: 全班同學都恭喜米亞考上了她的夢想學校。

en: The scientists will meet at an international congress on climate change next year.
zh: 這些科學家明年將在一場關於氣候變遷的國際大會上會面。

en: With her friends' support, Amy finally conquered her fear of speaking in public.
zh: 在朋友的支持下，艾咪終於克服了上台說話的恐懼。

en: Ben's conscience told him to return the extra change to the shop owner.
zh: 班的良心告訴他要把多找的零錢還給店老闆。

en: Staying up late every night can have serious consequences for your health.
zh: 每晚熬夜可能對健康造成嚴重的後果。

en: Heavy rain fell all week, and the consequent floods closed many roads.
zh: 大雨下了一整個星期，隨之而來的水災使許多道路封閉。

en: My grandparents are quite conservative and don't like big changes.
zh: 我的祖父母相當保守，不喜歡太大的改變。

en: Our dance club consists of fifteen members from three different grades.
zh: 我們的熱舞社由三個不同年級的十五名社員組成。

en: Lisa's grades have been consistent all year, always near the top of her class.
zh: 麗莎整年的成績都很穩定，一直名列班上前茅。

en: Girls constitute more than half of the students in our school.
zh: 女生占我們學校學生的一半以上。

en: Grandpa has a strong constitution and rarely catches a cold.
zh: 爺爺體質很好，很少感冒。

en: The town plans to construct a new library near the park.
zh: 鎮上計畫在公園附近建造一座新圖書館。

en: The new metro station is still under construction and will open next year.
zh: 新的捷運站還在興建中，明年才會啟用。

en: Thanks for your constructive advice; it really helped me improve my report.
zh: 謝謝你提供建設性的建議，真的幫助我改進了報告。

en: You should consult a doctor if your cough doesn't get better.
zh: 如果你的咳嗽一直沒有好轉，就應該去看醫生。

en: The school hired a consultant to help plan the new library.
zh: 學校聘請了一位顧問來協助規劃新圖書館。

en: Older refrigerators consume much more electricity than new ones, so they cost more.
zh: 舊冰箱比新冰箱耗電得多，所以花費也比較高。

en: More and more consumers are buying food and clothes online instead of in stores.
zh: 越來越多消費者在網路上而不是在店裡購買食物和衣服。

en: Bring your own container when you buy food, and you'll reduce plastic waste.
zh: 買食物時自備容器，就能減少塑膠垃圾。

en: The content of the video is great, but the sound quality is poor.
zh: 這部影片的內容很棒，但音質很差。

en: Grandma smiled with contentment as she watched her family eat dinner together.
zh: 奶奶看著全家人一起吃晚餐，臉上露出滿足的微笑。

en: Lisa took part in a singing contest and won second place.
zh: 麗莎參加了一場歌唱比賽，得到第二名。

en: If you don't know a word, try to guess its meaning from the context.
zh: 如果你不認識某個單字，試著從上下文猜出它的意思。

en: The continual noise from the street made it hard for Mia to sleep.
zh: 街上不斷傳來的噪音讓米亞很難入睡。

en: It rained for five continuous days, so the soccer game was canceled.
zh: 連續下了五天雨，所以足球比賽取消了。

en: Ben thought the test would be hard; on the contrary, it was very easy.
zh: 班以為考試會很難；相反地，題目非常簡單。

en: There is a sharp contrast between the busy city and the quiet countryside.
zh: 熱鬧的城市和寧靜的鄉村形成了強烈的對比。

en: Everyone in the group contributed ideas for the class poster.
zh: 組裡的每個人都為班級海報貢獻了點子。

en: Each student made a contribution to the birthday gift for our class teacher.
zh: 每位學生都為送給導師的生日禮物出了一份力。

en: For your convenience, the library is open until ten on weekdays.
zh: 為了方便大家，圖書館平日開放到晚上十點。

en: Shaking hands when meeting someone is a common social convention.
zh: 與人見面時握手是一種常見的社交慣例。

en: Instead of a conventional classroom, the lesson was held in the school garden.
zh: 這堂課不是在傳統的教室裡上，而是在學校花園裡進行。

en: Amy conversed with the exchange students in English during lunch.
zh: 午餐時間，艾咪用英語和交換學生交談。

en: Her smile conveyed how happy she was to see her old friends.
zh: 她的笑容傳達出她見到老朋友有多開心。

en: Lisa tried to convince her parents to let her join the trip.
zh: 麗莎試著說服父母讓她參加這趟旅行。

en: The two classes cooperated to clean up the beach on Saturday.
zh: 兩個班級星期六合作清理海灘。

en: Thanks to everyone's cooperation, the school fair was a big success.
zh: 多虧大家的合作，校慶園遊會辦得非常成功。

en: The students were very cooperative and finished the group project quickly.
zh: 學生們非常配合，很快就完成了小組專題。

en: Talking to friends helps many students cope with stress before exams.
zh: 和朋友聊天能幫助許多學生應付考前的壓力。

en: Copper is often used in electric wires because it carries electricity well.
zh: 銅常被用來做電線，因為它的導電性很好。

en: Be careful not to step on the long electric cord on the floor.
zh: 小心不要踩到地上那條長長的電線。

en: Your answer doesn't correspond to the question, so please read it again.
zh: 你的答案和題目不符，請再讀一次題目。

en: Each student wore a funny costume for the drama club's show.
zh: 每位學生都穿上滑稽的戲服參加戲劇社的演出。

en: We stayed in a small cottage near the lake during summer vacation.
zh: 暑假期間，我們住在湖邊的一間小屋裡。

en: Lisa was elected to the student council and helps plan school events.
zh: 麗莎被選進學生會，協助規劃學校活動。

en: Please pay for your drinks at the counter near the door.
zh: 請到門口附近的櫃檯付飲料的錢。

en: It was courageous of Ben to admit his mistake in front of the class.
zh: 班敢在全班面前承認自己的錯誤，真是勇敢。

en: It is common courtesy to say thank you when someone helps you.
zh: 別人幫助你時說聲謝謝，是基本的禮貌。

en: Don't call him a coward just because he's afraid of the dark.
zh: 別只因為他怕黑就說他是膽小鬼。

en: There is a crack in my phone screen after I dropped it.
zh: 我的手機摔到之後，螢幕上出現了一道裂痕。

en: At the night market, Lisa bought some beautiful handmade bamboo crafts.
zh: 麗莎在夜市買了一些漂亮的手工竹製工藝品。

en: This cake is the baker's newest creation, and it tastes amazing.
zh: 這個蛋糕是烘焙師的最新作品，吃起來美味極了。

en: The art teacher encourages us to use our creativity instead of copying pictures.
zh: 美術老師鼓勵我們發揮創造力，而不是照著圖片畫。

en: Amy crept downstairs quietly so she wouldn't wake up her parents.
zh: 艾咪躡手躡腳地下樓，以免吵醒她的父母。

en: Most film critics praised the movie for its beautiful music.
zh: 大多數影評人都稱讚這部電影的配樂很優美。

en: Getting enough sleep is critical for students' health and learning.
zh: 充足的睡眠對學生的健康和學習非常關鍵。

en: Lisa listened carefully to her coach's criticism and tried to improve.
zh: 麗莎仔細聆聽教練的批評，並努力改進。

en: It isn't kind to criticize people for the way they look.
zh: 因為別人的外表而批評他們是不厚道的。

en: The club works to stop cruelty to animals and finds homes for homeless dogs.
zh: 這個社團致力於阻止虐待動物，並為流浪狗尋找新家。

en: These fried chicken pieces are hot and crunchy, just the way I like them.
zh: 這些炸雞塊又熱又酥脆，正是我喜歡的樣子。

en: Crush two pieces of garlic and add them to the hot oil in the pan.
zh: 把兩瓣大蒜壓碎，放進鍋裡的熱油中。

en: Mia put a few ice cubes in her lemon tea to cool it down.
zh: 米亞在檸檬茶裡放了幾塊冰塊讓它變涼。

en: When the music stops, that's your cue to walk onto the stage.
zh: 音樂一停，就是你上台的提示。

en: In the story, a cunning fox tricks the crow into dropping its cheese.
zh: 在故事裡，一隻狡猾的狐狸騙烏鴉把嘴裡的起司掉下來。

en: Out of curiosity, Lisa opened the old box she found in Grandma's room.
zh: 出於好奇，麗莎打開了她在奶奶房間找到的舊箱子。

en: The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep in the sun.
zh: 貓咪在沙發上蜷成一團，在陽光下睡著了。

en: In the fairy tale, an evil fairy puts a curse on the princess.
zh: 在童話故事中，一個邪惡的仙女對公主下了詛咒。

en: The road follows the curve of the river through the green valley.
zh: 這條路沿著河流的彎道穿過翠綠的山谷。

en: Lisa put a soft cushion behind her back while studying at her desk.
zh: 麗莎在書桌前讀書時，在背後放了一個柔軟的靠墊。

en: Don't put on that shirt yet; it's still damp from the rain.
zh: 先別穿那件襯衫，它被雨淋得還濕濕的。

en: The deadline for the science report is Friday, so our group must finish it soon.
zh: 科學報告的截止期限是星期五，所以我們這組必須盡快完成。

en: The principal declared that school would be closed tomorrow because of the typhoon.
zh: 校長宣布明天因為颱風停課。

en: We spent the whole afternoon putting up decorations for the class Christmas party.
zh: 我們花了一整個下午為班上的聖誕派對布置裝飾。

en: Our volleyball team defeated the strongest school in the city and won the final game.
zh: 我們的排球隊擊敗了市內最強的學校，贏得決賽。

en: Lisa bravely defended her friend when some classmates laughed at her drawing.
zh: 當一些同學嘲笑她朋友的畫時，Lisa 勇敢地為朋友辯護。

en: Washing your hands often is a simple defense against colds and other illnesses.
zh: 常洗手是對抗感冒和其他疾病的簡單防禦方法。

en: Ben's argument was clear and defensible, so the teacher gave him a high score.
zh: Ben 的論點清楚又站得住腳，所以老師給了他高分。

en: When her mom asked about her grades, Amy became defensive and refused to talk.
zh: 當媽媽問起她的成績時，Amy 變得充滿防衛心，拒絕說話。

en: We don't have a definite plan for the summer vacation yet, but we'll decide soon.
zh: 我們還沒有明確的暑假計畫，但很快就會決定。

en: Be careful with these delicate glass cups; they break very easily.
zh: 小心這些精緻的玻璃杯，它們很容易破。

en: To her delight, Mia's short story was chosen for the school magazine.
zh: 令 Mia 欣喜的是，她的短篇故事被選入了校刊。

en: We had a delightful afternoon at a small coffee shop near the river.
zh: 我們在河邊一家小咖啡店度過了一個愉快的下午。

en: Because of the hot weather, the demand for cold drinks has increased greatly.
zh: 因為天氣炎熱，冷飲的需求大幅增加。

en: The science teacher demonstrated how to mix the two liquids safely before the experiment.
zh: 自然老師在實驗前示範如何安全地混合這兩種液體。

en: The coach gave a quick demonstration of the correct way to hit the ball.
zh: 教練快速示範了擊球的正確方式。

en: The hikers got lost in the dense forest after the sun went down.
zh: 太陽下山後，登山客在茂密的森林裡迷路了。

en: Our school bus will depart at seven sharp, so please don't be late.
zh: 我們的校車七點整出發，所以請不要遲到。

en: Please check the departure time of your flight before you leave for the airport.
zh: 出發去機場前，請先確認班機的起飛時間。

en: Many teenagers today are too dependent on their phones and can't stop checking them.
zh: 現今許多青少年太依賴手機，忍不住一直查看。

en: Talking to friends and getting enough sleep can help prevent depression in teenagers.
zh: 和朋友聊天、睡眠充足，有助於預防青少年憂鬱。

en: You studied so hard this term that you really deserve a good rest.
zh: 你這學期這麼用功，真的值得好好休息一下。

en: The lost puppy was desperate for food and water after three days in the rain.
zh: 那隻走失的小狗在雨中待了三天，極度渴望食物和水。

en: Despite the heavy rain, hundreds of students came to the school sports day.
zh: 儘管下著大雨，仍有數百名學生來參加學校運動會。

en: The typhoon caused great destruction to the farms in the south of Taiwan.
zh: 颱風對台灣南部的農田造成了嚴重的破壞。

en: Amy loves reading detective stories and always tries to guess who did it.
zh: Amy 很喜歡看偵探小說，總是試著猜出是誰做的。

en: With great determination, Jenny practiced the piano every day and finally passed the test.
zh: 憑著堅定的決心，Jenny 每天練琴，終於通過了檢定。

en: Students are not allowed to use electronic devices during the exam.
zh: 考試期間學生不准使用電子裝置。

en: Our club devised a clever plan to get more students to join us.
zh: 我們社團想出了一個巧妙的計畫，吸引更多學生加入。

en: Mrs. Lin has devoted her whole life to teaching children in the mountains.
zh: 林老師把她的一生奉獻給山區孩子的教育。

en: Early in the morning, the grass in the park was wet with dew.
zh: 清晨時，公園裡的草地沾滿了露水。

en: The teacher drew a diagram on the board to show how the heart works.
zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一張圖解，說明心臟如何運作。

en: The two sisters differ greatly in personality, but they get along very well.
zh: 這兩姊妹個性差異很大，但她們相處得非常好。

en: Some people find it hard to digest milk, so they choose other drinks instead.
zh: 有些人很難消化牛奶，所以改選其他飲料。

en: Grandpa learned to use a digital camera to take photos of his garden.
zh: 爺爺學會用數位相機拍他花園的照片。

en: Every person, rich or poor, should be treated with dignity and respect.
zh: 每個人無論貧富，都應該受到有尊嚴、受尊重的對待。

en: Her diligence finally paid off when she got into her dream university.
zh: 當她考上夢想中的大學時，她的勤奮終於有了回報。

en: Kevin is a diligent student who always finishes his homework before dinner.
zh: Kevin 是個勤奮的學生，總是在晚餐前寫完作業。

en: After three years of hard work, the students proudly received their high school diplomas.
zh: 經過三年的努力，學生們驕傲地領到了高中畢業證書。

en: Jenny hopes to become a diplomat because she loves languages and other cultures.
zh: Jenny 希望成為外交官，因為她熱愛語言和其他文化。

en: The new library has an elevator so that people with disabilities can enter easily.
zh: 新圖書館設有電梯，讓身心障礙者能方便進出。

en: One disadvantage of living in the city is the noise from heavy traffic.
zh: 住在城市的一個缺點是繁忙交通帶來的噪音。

en: Lisa didn't want to disappoint her coach, so she practiced extra hours every day.
zh: Lisa 不想讓教練失望，所以每天額外多練習幾個小時。

en: Our class collected money to help families who lost their homes in the disaster.
zh: 我們班募款幫助在這場災難中失去家園的家庭。

en: The new coach believes discipline and hard work are the keys to a winning team.
zh: 新教練相信紀律和努力是一支常勝隊伍的關鍵。

en: Don't let one bad test score discourage you from studying math.
zh: 別讓一次考差的成績使你對學數學失去信心。

en: At the Halloween party, Ben disguised himself as an old man, and nobody recognized him.
zh: 在萬聖節派對上，Ben 把自己偽裝成老人，結果沒有人認出他。

en: To my disgust, someone had left rotten food under the desk in our classroom.
zh: 令我厭惡的是，有人把腐爛的食物留在我們教室的桌子底下。

en: The teacher dismissed the class ten minutes early because of the heavy rain.
zh: 因為下大雨，老師提早十分鐘讓全班下課。

en: After the party, the living room was in complete disorder, so we cleaned it together.
zh: 派對結束後，客廳一片混亂，所以我們一起打掃。

en: The two clubs had a dispute over who could use the music room on Friday.
zh: 兩個社團為了星期五誰能使用音樂教室而起了爭執。

en: The two kinds of tea look similar, but they have quite distinct tastes.
zh: 這兩種茶看起來很像，但味道明顯不同。

en: It's hard to distinguish between the twins because they dress and look the same.
zh: 這對雙胞胎穿著和長相都一樣，所以很難區別他們。

en: A distinguished scientist visited our school and gave a talk about the stars.
zh: 一位傑出的科學家來我們學校，發表了一場關於星星的演講。

en: Our class leader distributed the test papers to everyone at the start of class.
zh: 班長在上課一開始把考卷發給每個人。

en: The map shows the distribution of rain across Taiwan during the summer.
zh: 這張地圖顯示夏季台灣各地的雨量分布。

en: Our family moved to a quiet district with many parks and good schools.
zh: 我們家搬到了一個有許多公園和好學校的安靜地區。

en: Please don't disturb your sister; she is studying for tomorrow's exam.
zh: 請不要打擾你姊姊，她正在準備明天的考試。

en: Our school has a diverse group of students from many different countries.
zh: 我們學校有一群來自許多不同國家、背景多樣的學生。

en: The night market shows the city's cultural diversity, with food from all over the world.
zh: 這座夜市展現了城市的文化多樣性，有來自世界各地的食物。

en: The old temple was built to honor the divine spirits of the mountain.
zh: 這座古老的廟宇是為了敬奉山中的神靈而建。

en: After her parents' divorce, Emma lived with her mother but often visited her father.
zh: 父母離婚後，Emma 和媽媽同住，但常去探望爸爸。

en: In this game, players must dodge the ball or they will be out.
zh: 在這個遊戲中，玩家必須閃避球，否則就會出局。

en: Green is the dominant color in the painting, which makes it feel peaceful.
zh: 綠色是這幅畫的主色調，讓人感覺很平靜。

en: Our basketball team dominated the game and won by more than twenty points.
zh: 我們籃球隊主宰了整場比賽，贏了二十多分。

en: Please send me the first draft of your speech by Wednesday so I can check it.
zh: 請在星期三前把你的演講稿初稿寄給我，讓我可以檢查。

en: Many students dread the first day of school after a long summer vacation.
zh: 許多學生害怕漫長暑假後的開學第一天。

en: The small boat drifted slowly down the river after the rope broke.
zh: 繩子斷了之後，小船沿著河慢慢漂流而下。

en: Our school holds a fire drill twice a year so students know how to leave safely.
zh: 我們學校每年舉行兩次消防演練，讓學生知道如何安全離開。

en: The warm classroom made many students feel drowsy during the first class after lunch.
zh: 溫暖的教室讓許多學生在午餐後的第一堂課昏昏欲睡。

en: These hiking shoes are light but durable, so they're perfect for mountain trips.
zh: 這雙登山鞋輕巧又耐用，非常適合去爬山。

en: We found a box of old photos on a dusty shelf in Grandma's house.
zh: 我們在奶奶家一個滿是灰塵的架子上找到一盒舊照片。

en: Lisa dyed her old white T-shirt blue for the class sports day.
zh: Lisa 把她的舊白T恤染成藍色，準備在班級運動會上穿。

en: Our new English teacher is so dynamic that her classes are never boring.
zh: 我們的新英文老師很有活力，她的課從不無聊。

en: In history class, we learned about the famous poems of the Tang Dynasty.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學了唐朝的著名詩作。

en: He made an earnest effort to improve his English by reading every day.
zh: 他認真努力，每天閱讀來提升英文能力。

en: Lily put on her earphones and listened to music on the bus to school.
zh: Lily 戴上耳機，在搭公車上學的途中聽音樂。

en: Visitors bring great economic benefits to small towns near the mountains.
zh: 遊客為山區附近的小鎮帶來很大的經濟利益。

en: Taking the bus is more economical than taking a taxi to school every day.
zh: 搭公車上學比每天搭計程車更省錢。

en: My cousin studies economics at university and wants to work in a bank someday.
zh: 我表哥在大學讀經濟學，希望將來能在銀行工作。

en: The economist on the news said that food prices will keep rising this year.
zh: 新聞上的經濟學家說，今年食物價格會持續上漲。

en: The country's economy grew quickly after more factories were built.
zh: 在蓋了更多工廠之後，這個國家的經濟快速成長。

en: To improve her study efficiency, Kelly turns off her phone while doing homework.
zh: 為了提高讀書效率，Kelly 寫作業時會把手機關機。

en: This skirt has an elastic waist, so it is very comfortable to wear.
zh: 這件裙子是鬆緊腰頭，穿起來很舒服。

en: My brother is interested in electronics and enjoys building small robots.
zh: 我哥哥對電子學很有興趣，喜歡製作小型機器人。

en: Wearing a long blue dress, the singer looked elegant on the stage.
zh: 那位歌手穿著一件藍色長洋裝，在台上看起來很優雅。

en: My little sister is in the third grade at an elementary school near our home.
zh: 我妹妹在我們家附近的國小讀三年級。

en: Our team was eliminated in the first round, but we learned a lot.
zh: 我們隊在第一輪就被淘汰了，但我們學到很多。

en: This restaurant is too crowded, so let's go elsewhere for lunch.
zh: 這家餐廳太擠了，我們去別的地方吃午餐吧。

en: Amy felt embarrassed when she called her teacher "Mom" in front of the class.
zh: Amy 在全班面前把老師叫成「媽媽」時，覺得很尷尬。

en: If you lose your passport abroad, you should go to your country's embassy for help.
zh: 如果你在國外遺失護照，應該到你國家的大使館求助。

en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds just as we reached the top of the mountain.
zh: 就在我們抵達山頂時，太陽從雲層後面露了出來。

en: Our teacher puts a lot of emphasis on speaking English in class.
zh: 我們老師非常強調在課堂上說英文。

en: The Roman Empire was one of the largest empires in world history.
zh: 羅馬帝國是世界史上最大的帝國之一。

en: Please enclose a photo of yourself when you send in the form.
zh: 寄回表格時，請附上一張你本人的照片。

en: During our hike, we encountered a group of monkeys eating fruit by the road.
zh: 健行途中，我們遇到一群猴子在路邊吃水果。

en: Plastic waste in the ocean endangers sea turtles and many other sea animals.
zh: 海洋中的塑膠垃圾危及海龜和許多其他海洋動物。

en: The players had to endure the summer heat during their long practice outdoors.
zh: 球員們在戶外長時間練習時，必須忍受夏天的酷熱。

en: The school decided to enforce the no-phone rule more strictly during class.
zh: 學校決定在上課時更嚴格地執行禁用手機的規定。

en: Sarah wants to study engineering in college because she loves solving problems.
zh: Sarah 想在大學讀工程，因為她喜歡解決問題。

en: Could you enlarge this photo so we can put it on the classroom wall?
zh: 你可以把這張照片放大，讓我們貼在教室牆上嗎？

en: An enormous tree stands in the middle of our campus, giving shade to everyone.
zh: 一棵巨大的樹矗立在校園中央，為大家遮蔭。

en: Please check your answers again to ensure that you haven't made any mistakes.
zh: 請再檢查一次答案，確保你沒有犯任何錯誤。

en: For entertainment, the family often plays board games together on weekends.
zh: 這家人週末常一起玩桌遊當作娛樂。

en: The new club members showed great enthusiasm for learning traditional dance.
zh: 新社員對學習傳統舞蹈表現出極大的熱忱。

en: Our class discussed equality between boys and girls in sports and at work.
zh: 我們班討論了運動和職場上的男女平等。

en: The school bought new sports equipment, including balls, nets, and running shoes.
zh: 學校購買了新的運動設備，包括球、網子和跑鞋。

en: Grandpa often talks about the era when there were no phones or computers.
zh: 爺爺常聊起那個沒有手機也沒有電腦的時代。

en: Water is essential for all living things, so remember to drink enough every day.
zh: 水對所有生物都是必要的，所以記得每天喝足夠的水。

en: Our school band was established in 1990 and has won many awards.
zh: 我們學校的樂隊成立於1990年，得過許多獎。

en: Experts estimate that the new library will be finished by next spring.
zh: 專家估計新圖書館將在明年春天前完工。

en: Taiwan is home to many ethnic groups, each with its own language and culture.
zh: 台灣是許多民族的家園，每個民族都有自己的語言和文化。

en: Our teacher will evaluate each group's science project at the end of the month.
zh: 我們老師將在月底評估每一組的科學專題。

en: At the end of the term, students fill out an evaluation of each course.
zh: 學期末，學生要為每門課填寫評鑑表。

en: After many failed tries, the team's eventual success made everyone very proud.
zh: 經過多次失敗的嘗試，這支隊伍最終的成功讓大家都很驕傲。

en: There is clear evidence that getting enough sleep helps students do better in school.
zh: 有明確的證據顯示，睡眠充足有助於學生在學校表現得更好。

en: It was evident from her smile that Lisa had passed the driving test.
zh: 從 Lisa 的笑容很明顯看得出她通過了駕照考試。

en: Ben always exaggerates; he said the fish he caught was as big as a car.
zh: Ben 總是誇大其詞，他說他釣到的魚跟車子一樣大。

en: Everyone in our class passed the test, with the exception of two students.
zh: 除了兩名學生之外，我們班每個人都通過了考試。

en: The long hike in the hot sun completely exhausted us.
zh: 在大太陽下長途健行讓我們完全筋疲力盡。

en: The museum is exhibiting paintings by young artists from all over Taiwan.
zh: 博物館正在展出來自台灣各地年輕藝術家的畫作。

en: The small restaurant plans to expand its menu by adding more healthy dishes.
zh: 這家小餐廳打算增加更多健康的菜色來擴充菜單。

en: The expansion of the school library means students will have more space to study.
zh: 學校圖書館的擴建意味著學生會有更多讀書空間。

en: The scientists are testing an experimental medicine that may help people sleep better.
zh: 科學家正在測試一種可能幫助人們睡得更好的實驗性藥物。

en: Thanks to the teacher's clear explanation, I finally understood the math problem.
zh: 多虧老師清楚的解釋，我終於懂了這道數學題。

en: The explosion of fireworks over the river lit up the night sky beautifully.
zh: 煙火在河面上空爆炸，把夜空照耀得十分美麗。

en: Some gases are highly explosive, so never light a fire near them.
zh: 有些氣體極易爆炸，所以千萬不要在附近點火。

en: Don't expose your skin to strong sunlight for too long in summer.
zh: 夏天不要讓皮膚長時間暴露在強烈的陽光下。

en: Too much exposure to phone screens before bed can make it hard to sleep.
zh: 睡前過度暴露在手機螢幕前，可能讓人難以入睡。

en: The library has extended its opening hours during the exam period.
zh: 考試期間圖書館延長了開放時間。

en: To some extent, I agree with you, but I still think the plan needs changes.
zh: 在某種程度上我同意你，但我仍覺得這個計畫需要修改。

en: The actor's facial expressions showed his feelings without a single word.
zh: 這位演員的臉部表情不用一句話就表達出他的情感。

en: Our new school gym has excellent facilities, including a swimming pool.
zh: 我們學校的新體育館設施很棒，還有一座游泳池。

en: The faithful dog waited at the station for its owner every evening.
zh: 那隻忠實的狗每天傍晚都在車站等主人。

en: The young singer rose to fame after her video was shared millions of times.
zh: 這位年輕歌手在影片被分享數百萬次後一舉成名。

en: We had a fantastic time at the beach and didn't want to go home.
zh: 我們在海邊玩得非常開心，都不想回家了。

en: Many teenagers enjoy fantasy novels full of magic and strange creatures.
zh: 許多青少年喜歡充滿魔法和奇異生物的奇幻小說。

en: Our class held a farewell party for Ms. Chen, who is moving to Canada.
zh: 我們班為即將搬到加拿大的陳老師舉辦了一場歡送會。

en: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
zh: 飛機起飛前請繫好安全帶。

en: Eating certain wild mushrooms can be fatal, so never pick them in the forest.
zh: 吃某些野生菇類可能致命，所以千萬不要在森林裡採來吃。

en: The weather was favorable, so the school trip went ahead as planned.
zh: 天氣條件有利，所以校外教學如期舉行。

en: In the past, offices sent important papers to each other by fax.
zh: 過去，辦公室之間會用傳真互傳重要文件。

en: On Chinese New Year's Eve, our whole family enjoys a big feast at Grandma's house.
zh: 除夕夜，我們全家會在奶奶家一起享用豐盛的大餐。

en: The teacher gave us helpful feedback on our speeches so we could improve them.
zh: 老師針對我們的演講給了有用的回饋，讓我們可以改進。

en: We took a ferry to the small island and rode bikes around it.
zh: 我們搭渡輪到那座小島，騎腳踏車環島。

en: The land near the river is fertile, so farmers grow rice and vegetables there.
zh: 河邊的土地很肥沃，所以農夫在那裡種稻米和蔬菜。

en: Could you fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen, please?
zh: 可以請你去廚房幫我拿一杯水來嗎？

en: She prefers reading fiction to science books because she loves made-up stories.
zh: 比起科學書，她更喜歡讀小說，因為她熱愛虛構的故事。

en: The fierce dog barked loudly at everyone who walked past the gate.
zh: 那隻兇猛的狗對每個經過大門的人大聲吠叫。

en: The school will finance the trip for students who cannot afford it.
zh: 學校將資助負擔不起旅費的學生參加這趟旅行。

en: Many college students need financial help from their parents to pay for school.
zh: 許多大學生需要父母的經濟援助來支付學費。

en: On cold winter nights, the family sat by the fireplace and told stories.
zh: 在寒冷的冬夜，一家人坐在壁爐旁講故事。

en: He flattered the teacher, hoping she would give him a better grade.
zh: 他奉承老師，希望她能給他更好的成績。

en: Our cat kept scratching itself, and the doctor found fleas in its fur.
zh: 我們的貓一直抓癢，醫生在牠的毛裡發現了跳蚤。

en: When the fire started, everyone in the building fled through the back door.
zh: 火災發生時，大樓裡的每個人都從後門逃離。

en: Working part-time at the bookstore gives Amy a flexible schedule for her studies.
zh: 在書店打工讓 Amy 能有彈性地安排念書時間。

en: After living in Japan for two years, Kevin became fluent in Japanese.
zh: 在日本住了兩年後，Kevin 的日文變得很流利。

en: Always remember to flush the toilet and wash your hands afterward.
zh: 上完廁所一定要記得沖水並洗手。

en: The waiter drew a heart shape in the milk foam on top of my coffee.
zh: 服務生在我咖啡上的奶泡畫了一顆愛心。

en: My parents forbid me to stay out after ten o'clock at night.
zh: 我爸媽禁止我晚上十點以後還待在外面。

en: The weather forecast says it will rain all weekend, so take an umbrella.
zh: 天氣預報說整個週末都會下雨，所以要帶傘。

en: The wild geese flew south in a V formation across the autumn sky.
zh: 雁群排成V字形隊伍，飛越秋天的天空往南飛去。

en: Students need to remember this math formula for the test next week.
zh: 學生需要記住這個數學公式，準備下週的考試。

en: We visited an old fort that was built by the Dutch in Tainan.
zh: 我們參觀了一座荷蘭人在台南建造的古老堡壘。

en: We were fortunate to have sunny weather for our class trip to the beach.
zh: 我們很幸運，班上去海邊旅行時天氣晴朗。

en: The children were excited to see dinosaur fossils at the science museum.
zh: 孩子們在科學博物館看到恐龍化石，非常興奮。

en: Reading every day builds a strong foundation for learning a language.
zh: 每天閱讀能為學習語言打下穩固的基礎。

en: The founder of our school believed that every child should get a good education.
zh: 我們學校的創辦人相信每個孩子都應該接受良好的教育。

en: Please handle the box carefully because the glasses inside are fragile.
zh: 請小心搬這個箱子，因為裡面的玻璃杯很易碎。

en: Mom put our family photo in a wooden frame and hung it on the wall.
zh: 媽媽把我們的全家福放進木製相框，掛在牆上。

en: The frequency of typhoons in Taiwan is highest from July to September.
zh: 台灣颱風發生的頻率在七月到九月最高。

en: As a freshman, Amy joined three clubs to make new friends quickly.
zh: 身為新生，Amy 參加了三個社團，好快點交到新朋友。

en: On winter mornings in the mountains, frost covers the grass and the car windows.
zh: 山上的冬天早晨，霜覆蓋著草地和車窗。

en: Dad frowned when he saw the messy kitchen after our party.
zh: 爸爸看到我們派對後一團亂的廚房時，皺起了眉頭。

en: It frustrates me when my computer stops working in the middle of my homework.
zh: 作業寫到一半電腦突然當機時，讓我很挫折。

en: Lucy cried in frustration after failing her driving test for the third time.
zh: Lucy 第三次沒通過駕照考試後，挫折地哭了出來。

en: She worked hard for years and finally fulfilled her dream of becoming a nurse.
zh: 她努力了好幾年，終於實現了成為護理師的夢想。

en: The new bag is simple but functional, with lots of useful pockets.
zh: 這個新包包簡單但實用，有許多好用的口袋。

en: Honesty and trust are fundamental parts of any good friendship.
zh: 誠實和信任是任何良好友誼的根本要素。

en: The whole family gathered at Grandpa's funeral and shared happy memories of him.
zh: 全家人聚集在爺爺的葬禮上，分享關於他的美好回憶。

en: Mom was furious when she found out I had lied about my homework.
zh: 媽媽發現我在作業的事情上說謊時，非常生氣。

en: They furnished their new apartment with simple wooden furniture and many green plants.
zh: 他們用簡單的木製家具和許多綠色植物布置新公寓。

en: The coffee shop is quiet; furthermore, its prices are low enough for students.
zh: 這家咖啡店很安靜；此外，價格對學生來說也夠便宜。

en: We spent Saturday afternoon at an art gallery looking at modern paintings.
zh: 我們星期六下午在一間畫廊欣賞現代畫作。

en: Lisa sat by the window, gazing at the stars in the night sky.
zh: Lisa 坐在窗邊，凝視著夜空中的星星。

en: Before the camping trip, we checked that we had all the gear we needed.
zh: 露營之前，我們檢查是否帶齊了所有需要的裝備。

en: In our school, students of any gender can join the soccer team.
zh: 在我們學校，不論性別，學生都可以加入足球隊。

en: Scientists believe that genes play a big role in how tall we grow.
zh: 科學家認為，基因對我們能長多高有很大的影響。

en: Grandma says that the younger generation spends too much time on their phones.
zh: 奶奶說年輕一代花太多時間在手機上。

en: Thanks to the generosity of local shops, our club could hold a free concert.
zh: 多虧當地商家的慷慨，我們社團才能舉辦一場免費音樂會。

en: Mozart was a musical genius who wrote his first song at the age of five.
zh: 莫札特是位音樂天才，五歲就寫出了第一首曲子。

en: Her smile was genuine, and everyone could tell she was truly happy for us.
zh: 她的笑容很真誠，大家都看得出她真心為我們高興。

en: Wash your hands with soap before meals to get rid of germs.
zh: 飯前用肥皂洗手，可以除去細菌。

en: Jenny is a gifted artist; her paintings have won many prizes.
zh: Jenny 是個有天賦的畫家，她的畫作贏得了許多獎項。

en: We saw a gigantic whale jump out of the sea during our boat trip.
zh: 搭船出遊時，我們看見一隻巨大的鯨魚躍出海面。

en: The little girls giggled as they whispered secrets to each other.
zh: 小女孩們一邊互相說悄悄話，一邊咯咯地笑。

en: When I have a cold, Grandma makes me hot ginger tea with brown sugar.
zh: 我感冒時，奶奶會煮熱熱的黑糖薑茶給我喝。

en: Fans waited for hours outside the hotel to catch a glimpse of the famous singer.
zh: 粉絲在飯店外等了好幾個小時，只為看那位知名歌手一眼。

en: The teacher spun the globe and asked us to find Taiwan on it.
zh: 老師轉動地球儀，要我們在上面找出台灣。

en: We woke up early to watch the glorious sunrise over the sea.
zh: 我們早起觀看海上壯麗的日出。

en: The night market sells all kinds of goods, from clothes to phone cases.
zh: 夜市販賣各式各樣的商品，從衣服到手機殼都有。

en: At the concert, the singer wore a beautiful long white gown.
zh: 在音樂會上，那位歌手穿著一件美麗的白色長禮服。

en: The dancer moved across the stage with such grace that everyone stopped talking.
zh: 那位舞者在台上舞動得如此優雅，讓所有人都停止交談。

en: Swans look so graceful as they swim slowly across the quiet lake.
zh: 天鵝慢慢游過平靜的湖面時，看起來非常優雅。

en: Our host family was gracious and made us feel at home right away.
zh: 我們的寄宿家庭親切有禮，讓我們馬上有賓至如歸的感覺。

en: Our whole family came to watch my sister's graduation from high school last June.
zh: 去年六月，我們全家都來看姊姊的高中畢業典禮。

en: Our English teacher explains grammar rules with funny examples, so they're easy to remember.
zh: 我們的英文老師用有趣的例子解釋文法規則，所以很好記。

en: Please check your writing for spelling and grammatical mistakes before you hand it in.
zh: 交出去之前，請檢查你寫的內容有沒有拼字和文法錯誤。

en: This graph shows how the number of students in our school has changed.
zh: 這張圖表顯示了我們學校學生人數的變化。

en: I'm really grateful to my friends for helping me when I was sick.
zh: 我真的很感激朋友們在我生病時幫助我。

en: We wrote cards to express our gratitude to the school cleaning staff.
zh: 我們寫卡片向學校清潔人員表達感激之意。

en: Every spring, our family visits Grandpa's grave to clean it and bring flowers.
zh: 每年春天，我們家都會去爺爺的墳前掃墓並獻花。

en: Fried chicken is tasty, but it's too greasy to eat every day.
zh: 炸雞很好吃，但太油膩了，不適合每天吃。

en: Lisa sent holiday greetings to all her friends on New Year's Day.
zh: Lisa 在元旦那天向所有朋友傳送節日問候。

en: After her cat died, Mia was filled with grief for weeks.
zh: 貓死後，Mia 好幾個星期都沉浸在悲痛中。

en: Dad likes to grind fresh coffee beans every morning before breakfast.
zh: 爸爸喜歡每天早上在早餐前現磨咖啡豆。

en: Hard work can't guarantee success, but it certainly gives you a better chance.
zh: 努力不能保證成功，但一定能讓你有更好的機會。

en: Students need a parent or guardian to sign the form before joining the trip.
zh: 學生必須請父母或監護人在表格上簽名，才能參加旅行。

en: Amy felt a strong sense of guilt after she forgot her best friend's birthday.
zh: Amy 忘了好朋友的生日後，感到強烈的罪惡感。

en: Ben felt guilty about eating the last piece of cake without asking his sister.
zh: Ben 沒問妹妹就吃掉最後一塊蛋糕，覺得很內疚。

en: Our boat sailed across the calm blue water of the gulf to a small fishing town.
zh: 我們的船駛過海灣平靜的藍色海水，前往一座小漁港。

en: Being late has become habitual for Kevin, so his teacher gave him a warning.
zh: 遲到已經成了 Kevin 的習慣，所以老師給了他警告。

en: The game came to a halt when heavy rain began to fall.
zh: 大雨開始落下時，比賽被迫停止。

en: Her handwriting is so neat that classmates often borrow her notes.
zh: 她的筆跡非常工整，所以同學常常借她的筆記。

en: Her grandparents faced many hardships when they were young, but they never gave up.
zh: 她的祖父母年輕時面臨許多艱難，但他們從未放棄。

en: The computer hardware in our classroom is old, so it runs very slowly.
zh: 我們教室裡的電腦硬體很舊，所以跑得很慢。

en: The singers sang in perfect harmony at the school concert last night.
zh: 昨晚的學校音樂會上，歌手們唱出了完美的和聲。

en: The coach's harsh words made some of the younger players cry.
zh: 教練嚴厲的話讓一些年紀較小的球員哭了。

en: In her haste to catch the bus, Lucy left her lunch box at home.
zh: Lucy 匆忙趕公車，結果把午餐盒忘在家裡。

en: The warm weather hastened the opening of the cherry flowers in the park.
zh: 溫暖的天氣加快了公園裡櫻花綻放的速度。

en: The story shows how love and kindness can win over hatred.
zh: 這個故事展現了愛與善良如何戰勝仇恨。

en: A hawk flew high above the field, looking for mice to catch.
zh: 一隻老鷹在田野上空高飛，尋找可以捕捉的老鼠。

en: A helicopter flew over the mountain to help the lost hikers.
zh: 一架直升機飛越山區，去救援迷路的登山客。

en: A herd of cows was eating grass peacefully on the hillside.
zh: 一群牛在山坡上安靜地吃草。

en: Without any hesitation, Lily raised her hand to answer the teacher's question.
zh: Lily 毫不猶豫地舉手回答老師的問題。

en: The farmer showed us how bees make honey inside the hive.
zh: 農夫向我們展示蜜蜂如何在蜂巢裡製造蜂蜜。

en: After living abroad for ten years, she finally returned to her homeland.
zh: 在國外住了十年後，她終於回到了家鄉。

en: My aunt and uncle went to Japan for their honeymoon after the wedding.
zh: 我阿姨和姨丈在婚禮後去日本度蜜月。

en: Please hang your wet jacket on the hook behind the classroom door.
zh: 請把你的濕外套掛在教室門後的掛鉤上。

en: We watched the sun slowly sink below the horizon from the beach.
zh: 我們在海邊看著太陽慢慢沉到地平線下。

en: Mom was horrified to see the huge spider on the kitchen wall.
zh: 媽媽看到廚房牆上的大蜘蛛時，嚇壞了。

en: Dad used a hose to wash the car in front of our house.
zh: 爸爸用水管在我們家門前洗車。

en: In our family, everyone shares household tasks like cooking and doing the dishes.
zh: 在我們家，每個人都分擔煮飯、洗碗等家務。

en: Ben helps with the housework by washing the dishes after dinner every night.
zh: Ben 每天晚餐後洗碗，幫忙做家事。

en: Helping strangers in need shows the best side of humanity.
zh: 幫助有需要的陌生人，展現了人性最美好的一面。

en: Summer in Taiwan is hard to bear because of the high humidity.
zh: 台灣的夏天因為濕度高而令人難以忍受。

en: The hurricane brought strong winds and heavy rain to the east coast of America.
zh: 颶風為美國東岸帶來強風和豪雨。

en: The teacher hushed the noisy class by raising her hand.
zh: 老師舉起手，讓吵鬧的班級安靜下來。

en: Scientists say that hydrogen is the lightest gas in the universe.
zh: 科學家說，氫是宇宙中最輕的氣體。

en: The twins wear identical clothes, so it's hard to tell them apart.
zh: 這對雙胞胎穿一模一樣的衣服，所以很難分辨他們。

en: You need to show some identification, such as a student card, to borrow books.
zh: 你需要出示身分證明，例如學生證，才能借書。

en: Can you identify this bird just from the sound it makes?
zh: 你能只靠叫聲就辨認出這是什麼鳥嗎？

en: The teacher explained the idiom "a piece of cake" with a funny story.
zh: 老師用一個有趣的故事解釋了「a piece of cake」這個慣用語。

en: Instead of sitting idle all summer, Lisa found a part-time job at the library.
zh: 麗莎沒有整個暑假閒著，而是在圖書館找了一份打工。

en: Many fans waited outside the TV station for hours just to see their idol.
zh: 許多粉絲在電視台外等了好幾個小時，只為了見偶像一面。

en: His ignorance of basic safety rules almost caused a fire in the kitchen.
zh: 他對基本安全規則的無知，差點讓廚房失火。

en: Before the class trip, many students were ignorant of the island's history.
zh: 班級旅行之前，許多學生對這座島的歷史一無所知。

en: The teacher used a simple drawing to illustrate how the heart works.
zh: 老師用一張簡單的圖來說明心臟如何運作。

en: Each page of this children's book has a colorful illustration of animals.
zh: 這本童書的每一頁都有一幅色彩繽紛的動物插圖。

en: When she was five, Amy had an imaginary friend who lived under her bed.
zh: 艾咪五歲時，有一個住在她床底下的想像朋友。

en: Her imaginative story about a cat who could fly won first prize at school.
zh: 她那篇關於會飛的貓、充滿想像力的故事，在學校得了第一名。

en: Little children often imitate the way their parents talk and walk.
zh: 小孩子常常模仿父母說話和走路的樣子。

en: The bag looks expensive, but it is actually a cheap imitation.
zh: 這個包包看起來很貴，但其實是便宜的仿製品。

en: Many immigrants have opened small restaurants in our neighborhood, selling food from home.
zh: 許多移民在我們社區開了小餐館，賣家鄉的料理。

en: Her grandparents immigrated to Canada in the 1980s to start a new life.
zh: 她的祖父母在1980年代移民到加拿大，展開新生活。

en: We waited in a long line at immigration after landing at the airport.
zh: 飛機降落後，我們在入境審查處排了很長的隊。

en: Social media can have a big impact on how teenagers see themselves.
zh: 社群媒體會大大影響青少年如何看待自己。

en: By asking about my homework, Mom implied that I should put down my phone.
zh: 媽媽問起我的功課，暗示我該把手機放下了。

en: Parents should not impose their own dreams on their children.
zh: 父母不應該把自己的夢想強加在孩子身上。

en: Lisa wore a neat shirt to make a good impression at the interview.
zh: 麗莎穿了一件整齊的襯衫，想在面試時留下好印象。

en: No one was hurt in the incident, but the bus arrived at school very late.
zh: 這起事件中沒有人受傷，但公車很晚才抵達學校。

en: Everyone in my family, including my grandma, loves bubble tea.
zh: 我家每個人都愛喝珍珠奶茶，包括我奶奶。

en: The view from the mountaintop at sunrise was so incredible that we forgot the cold.
zh: 日出時山頂的景色美得難以置信，讓我們忘了寒冷。

en: Dark clouds in the sky are often an indication that rain is coming.
zh: 天空出現烏雲，通常是快要下雨的跡象。

en: The infant slept peacefully in her mother's arms during the whole flight.
zh: 整趟飛行中，那個嬰兒都安穩地睡在媽媽懷裡。

en: Wash the cut with clean water and cover it to prevent infection.
zh: 用乾淨的水清洗傷口並包紮起來，以防感染。

en: Because of inflation, a bowl of beef noodles now costs much more than before.
zh: 由於通貨膨脹，一碗牛肉麵現在比以前貴多了。

en: Her cooking videos made her one of the most influential people on social media.
zh: 她的烹飪影片讓她成為社群媒體上最有影響力的人之一。

en: The museum tour was fun and informative; we learned a lot about ocean life.
zh: 這趟博物館導覽既有趣又富有知識性，我們學到很多海洋生物的知識。

en: Fresh fruit is the most important ingredient in this summer dessert.
zh: 新鮮水果是這道夏日甜點最重要的材料。

en: My initial plan was to study all night, but I fell asleep at ten.
zh: 我最初的計畫是熬夜讀書，結果十點就睡著了。

en: Amy injured her knee during basketball practice and had to rest for weeks.
zh: 艾咪在籃球練習時傷了膝蓋，得休息好幾個星期。

en: The little boy's innocence made everyone smile when he asked where the sun sleeps.
zh: 小男孩天真地問太陽睡在哪裡，逗得大家都笑了。

en: The class leader asked for everyone's input before planning the field trip.
zh: 班長在規劃校外教學前，先徵詢了每個人的意見。

en: Insert a coin into the machine and choose the drink you want.
zh: 把硬幣投入機器，然後選擇你想要的飲料。

en: The school kitchen passed its health inspection with no problems.
zh: 學校廚房順利通過了衛生檢查，沒有任何問題。

en: Lisa often walks by the sea to find inspiration for her songs.
zh: 麗莎常常到海邊散步，為她的歌曲尋找靈感。

en: Her teacher's kind words inspired her to keep studying science.
zh: 老師親切的話語激勵她繼續研讀科學。

en: You need to install the app before you can join the online class.
zh: 你必須先安裝這個應用程式，才能參加線上課程。

en: Baby turtles follow their instinct and head straight for the sea.
zh: 小海龜依循本能，直接朝大海前進。

en: The coach instructed us to drink plenty of water during the long run.
zh: 教練指示我們在長跑時要喝足夠的水。

en: Our swimming instructor is patient with beginners who are afraid of water.
zh: 我們的游泳教練對怕水的初學者很有耐心。

en: Calling someone stupid is an insult, even if you say it as a joke.
zh: 說別人笨就是一種侮辱，即使你只是開玩笑。

en: Before traveling abroad, my parents always buy travel insurance for the whole family.
zh: 出國旅遊前，我爸媽總會替全家人買旅遊保險。

en: Reading books and solving puzzles are good for a child's intellectual development.
zh: 閱讀書籍和解謎有助於孩子的智力發展。

en: Dolphins are known for their high intelligence and ability to work in groups.
zh: 海豚以高智力和團體合作的能力聞名。

en: We intend to finish the science project before the weekend.
zh: 我們打算在週末前完成這份科學專題。

en: After a week of intense training, the team was ready for the big game.
zh: 經過一週的高強度訓練，球隊已準備好迎接大賽。

en: The intensity of the summer sun in Taiwan can burn your skin quickly.
zh: 台灣夏天的陽光強度很高，很快就會曬傷皮膚。

en: Before the exam, Amy took an intensive two-week English course.
zh: 考試前，艾咪上了為期兩週的英文密集課程。

en: I had no intention of hurting your feelings; I was just being honest.
zh: 我沒有要傷害你感情的意思，我只是說實話而已。

en: The new app lets students interact with teachers after class.
zh: 這個新的應用程式讓學生能在課後和老師互動。

en: Online chats can never fully replace face-to-face interaction with friends.
zh: 線上聊天永遠無法完全取代和朋友面對面的互動。

en: Using your phone late at night can interfere with your sleep.
zh: 深夜使用手機會妨礙你的睡眠。

en: After a year of lessons, Lisa moved up to the intermediate guitar class.
zh: 上了一年課之後，麗莎升上了中級吉他班。

en: Different readers may interpret the ending of the story in different ways.
zh: 不同的讀者可能會用不同的方式解讀這個故事的結局。

en: The teacher finished her talk without a single interruption from the students.
zh: 老師講完了整段話，學生沒有打斷過一次。

en: Only a few intimate friends were invited to Amy's small birthday party.
zh: 艾咪的小型生日派對只邀請了幾位親密好友。

en: Her intuition told her that something was wrong with her best friend.
zh: 她的直覺告訴她，她最好的朋友出了點狀況。

en: Every summer, ants invade our kitchen looking for sweet food.
zh: 每年夏天，螞蟻都會入侵我們的廚房找甜食。

en: The farmers worked hard to stop an invasion of insects that ate their crops.
zh: 農夫們努力阻止啃食作物的昆蟲入侵。

en: The invention of the smartphone has changed the way people communicate.
zh: 智慧型手機的發明改變了人們溝通的方式。

en: Lisa decided to invest her time in learning a second language.
zh: 麗莎決定把時間投資在學習第二外語上。

en: Scientists started an investigation into why so many fish died in the river.
zh: 科學家展開調查，想找出河裡為什麼死了這麼多魚。

en: The school play involved more than fifty students from different clubs.
zh: 這齣校園戲劇有來自不同社團的五十多位學生參與。

en: Sick students should stay home to isolate themselves and avoid spreading the flu.
zh: 生病的學生應該待在家裡自我隔離，避免傳播流感。

en: Living in isolation on a small island, the old man rarely saw other people.
zh: 那位老人孤立地住在一座小島上，很少見到其他人。

en: Plastic waste is a serious issue that our science class discussed today.
zh: 塑膠垃圾是我們自然課今天討論的一個嚴重議題。

en: Amy felt a touch of jealousy when her best friend made a new friend.
zh: 當最好的朋友交了新朋友時，艾咪感到一絲忌妒。

en: Lisa is keen on baking and makes cookies for her friends every weekend.
zh: 麗莎熱衷於烘焙，每個週末都會為朋友做餅乾。

en: Grandma put the kettle on to make tea for our guests.
zh: 奶奶把水壺放上爐子燒水，泡茶招待客人。

en: The children knelt down on the grass to look at the tiny flowers.
zh: 孩子們跪在草地上，仔細看那些小花。

en: She turned the knob slowly and opened the door to the dark room.
zh: 她慢慢轉動門把，打開了通往漆黑房間的門。

en: Building the new bridge took two years of hard labor.
zh: 建造這座新橋花了兩年的辛苦勞動。

en: Students must wear safety glasses when working in the school laboratory.
zh: 學生在學校實驗室做實驗時，必須戴上護目鏡。

en: Because of the slow Wi-Fi, there was a lag between the video and the sound.
zh: 因為網路很慢，影片的畫面和聲音之間出現了延遲。

en: Taipei 101 is a famous landmark that many tourists visit every year.
zh: 台北101是每年都有許多觀光客造訪的著名地標。

en: The mountain landscape in eastern Taiwan is beautiful in every season.
zh: 台灣東部的山景一年四季都很美。

en: The success of the school fair was largely due to the students' hard work.
zh: 校慶園遊會的成功，主要歸功於學生們的努力。

en: The company plans to launch a new phone model next month.
zh: 這家公司計畫下個月推出一款新手機。

en: Parking here is lawful only on weekends, so be careful on weekdays.
zh: 這裡只有週末停車才合法，所以平日要小心。

en: Amy leaned against the wall and waited for the bus to arrive.
zh: 艾咪靠著牆，等公車到來。

en: The learned old man in our village knows a lot about history and poems.
zh: 我們村裡那位博學的老先生對歷史和詩詞懂得很多。

en: We listened to a lecture on healthy eating in the school hall.
zh: 我們在學校禮堂聽了一場關於健康飲食的演講。

en: The guest lecturer showed us amazing photos of life under the sea.
zh: 客座講師給我們看了令人驚嘆的海底生物照片。

en: According to legend, a dragon once lived in this lake.
zh: 根據傳說，這座湖裡曾經住著一條龍。

en: On Sunday mornings, we enjoy a leisurely breakfast at a café near our home.
zh: 星期天早上，我們會在家附近的咖啡廳悠閒地吃早餐。

en: The school decided to lengthen the lunch break by ten minutes.
zh: 學校決定把午休時間延長十分鐘。

en: Nobody trusted him anymore after everyone found out he was a liar.
zh: 大家發現他是個說謊的人之後，就再也沒有人相信他了。

en: The librarian helped me find a book about the history of tea.
zh: 圖書館員幫我找到一本關於茶的歷史的書。

en: My older sister just got her driver's license, so she can drive us to school.
zh: 我姊姊剛考到駕照，所以她可以開車載我們上學。

en: Always swim near the lifeguard so someone can help you if you get into trouble.
zh: 一定要在救生員附近游泳，這樣遇到危險時才有人能幫你。

en: Everyone has some limitations, but hard work can still take you very far.
zh: 每個人都有一些限制，但努力仍然能帶你走得很遠。

en: The hotel changes the linen on every bed each morning.
zh: 這家飯店每天早上都會更換每張床的床單。

en: Lisa put on a little pink lipstick before taking photos with her friends.
zh: 麗莎和朋友拍照前，擦了一點粉紅色的口紅。

en: Stores in Taiwan are not allowed to sell liquor to anyone under eighteen.
zh: 台灣的商店不准賣酒給未滿十八歲的人。

en: Our school's literary club meets every Friday to share poems and short stories.
zh: 我們學校的文學社每週五聚會，分享詩和短篇故事。

en: Amy loves reading English literature, especially novels from the 1800s.
zh: 艾咪喜歡閱讀英國文學，尤其是十九世紀的小說。

en: Dad took out a loan from the bank to buy a new car.
zh: 爸爸向銀行貸款買了一輛新車。

en: We had fresh lobster for dinner at a seafood restaurant by the sea.
zh: 我們在海邊的海鮮餐廳吃了新鮮龍蝦當晚餐。

en: There is no logic in skipping breakfast to study more; you just get tired.
zh: 為了多讀書而不吃早餐毫無邏輯可言，只會讓你更累。

en: Lisa gave a clear and logical explanation of how she solved the math problem.
zh: 麗莎清楚又有條理地解釋了她如何解出那道數學題。

en: After the big dinner, Dad had to loosen his belt a little.
zh: 吃完豐盛的晚餐後，爸爸只好把皮帶鬆開一點。

en: The weather was lousy, so we watched movies at home all weekend.
zh: 天氣很糟，所以我們整個週末都在家看電影。

en: Our dog is very loyal and waits by the door every day for us.
zh: 我們的狗非常忠誠，每天都在門邊等我們回家。

en: The café gives every tenth coffee free to thank customers for their loyalty.
zh: 這家咖啡廳每買十杯就送一杯，感謝顧客的忠誠支持。

en: The hotel had a luxurious pool on the roof with a view of the city.
zh: 這家飯店的屋頂有一座奢華的泳池，可以俯瞰市景。

en: For students, eating at a fancy restaurant is a luxury.
zh: 對學生來說，在高級餐廳吃飯是一種奢侈。

en: Farmers today use modern machinery to harvest rice much faster.
zh: 現在的農夫使用現代機械，收割稻米快多了。

en: The fridge door is magnetic, so we stick photos and notes on it.
zh: 冰箱門有磁性，所以我們把照片和便條貼在上面。

en: From the plane, we saw a magnificent view of snowy mountains.
zh: 我們從飛機上看到了白雪覆蓋的群山，景色壯麗。

en: Amy doesn't wear much makeup; she prefers a natural look.
zh: 艾咪不太化妝，她比較喜歡自然的樣子。

en: Read the manual carefully before you use the new coffee machine.
zh: 使用新的咖啡機之前，請仔細閱讀使用手冊。

en: This factory manufactures bikes that are sold all over the world.
zh: 這間工廠製造的腳踏車銷往世界各地。

en: The phone manufacturer promised to fix the problem for free.
zh: 那家手機製造商承諾會免費修好這個問題。

en: Uncle Ben trained for six months before running his first marathon.
zh: 班叔叔訓練了六個月，才跑了他人生第一場馬拉松。

en: Write your notes in the margin of the page so you can review them later.
zh: 把筆記寫在頁邊空白處，方便你之後複習。

en: Lisa showed great maturity by staying calm during the argument.
zh: 麗莎在爭吵中保持冷靜，表現出很成熟的態度。

en: The elevator can carry a maximum of ten people at a time.
zh: 這部電梯一次最多可以載十個人。

en: Set measurable goals, such as reading two books a month.
zh: 設定可以衡量的目標，例如一個月讀兩本書。

en: The school took measures to keep students safe during the typhoon.
zh: 學校採取了措施，確保學生在颱風期間的安全。

en: The mechanic fixed Dad's car in less than an hour.
zh: 技工不到一小時就修好了爸爸的車。

en: The old clock stopped because of a mechanical problem inside it.
zh: 那座老時鐘因為內部的機械問題而停了。

en: Our class trip to the beach was the most memorable part of high school.
zh: 我們班的海邊旅行是高中生活中最難忘的一段回憶。

en: Every year, students lay flowers at the memorial for those who died in the earthquake.
zh: 每年學生們都會到紀念碑前獻花，悼念地震中的罹難者。

en: Amy memorized fifty new English words on the bus before the quiz.
zh: 小考前，艾咪在公車上背了五十個英文新單字。

en: In the past, merchants traveled by ship to sell tea and silk.
zh: 過去，商人搭船到各地販賣茶葉和絲綢。

en: The kind king showed mercy and let the poor thief go free.
zh: 仁慈的國王大發慈悲，放了那個可憐的小偷。

en: The whole three-day trip cost us a mere five hundred dollars.
zh: 整趟三天的旅行只花了我們區區五百元。

en: Each plan has its own merits, so let's discuss them before we vote.
zh: 每個方案都有各自的優點，我們投票前先討論一下吧。

en: In ancient times, messengers ran long distances to deliver important news.
zh: 古時候，信差要跑很遠的路去傳遞重要消息。

en: My brother's room is so messy that he can never find his socks.
zh: 我弟弟的房間亂到他永遠找不到自己的襪子。

en: Under the microscope, we could see tiny living things in a drop of water.
zh: 在顯微鏡下，我們可以看到一滴水裡的微小生物。

en: The weather in southern Taiwan stays mild even in the middle of winter.
zh: 即使在隆冬，南台灣的天氣依然溫和。

en: The old mill by the river once turned wheat into flour.
zh: 河邊那座老磨坊以前是把小麥磨成麵粉的。

en: He became a millionaire at twenty-five after his online game became popular.
zh: 他設計的線上遊戲爆紅後，他二十五歲就成了百萬富翁。

en: The miners worked deep underground for many hours each day.
zh: 礦工們每天在很深的地底下工作好幾個小時。

en: Fresh vegetables are rich in vitamins and minerals that keep us healthy.
zh: 新鮮蔬菜富含維生素和礦物質，能讓我們保持健康。

en: You need a minimum of six hours of sleep to stay focused in class.
zh: 你至少需要睡六個小時，上課才能保持專注。

en: The education minister visited our school to talk about new exam rules.
zh: 教育部長來我們學校談新的考試制度。

en: The Ministry of Education announced that schools will open a week later.
zh: 教育部宣布學校將延後一週開學。

en: The naughty kitten gets into mischief whenever we leave it alone.
zh: 每次我們把那隻頑皮的小貓單獨留下，牠就會搗蛋。

en: I felt miserable all day because I had a bad cold and a big test.
zh: 我得了重感冒又有大考，一整天都覺得很悲慘。

en: She had the misfortune of losing her phone on the first day of the trip.
zh: 她很不幸，在旅行第一天就弄丟了手機。

en: Some ads on social media can mislead young people about health products.
zh: 社群媒體上的一些廣告可能會在健康產品方面誤導年輕人。

en: Please don't misunderstand me; I only want to help you with your project.
zh: 請別誤會我，我只是想幫你做專題而已。

en: Doctors suggest doing moderate exercise for thirty minutes a day.
zh: 醫生建議每天做三十分鐘適度的運動。

en: Even after winning first place, Lisa remained modest and thanked her teammates.
zh: 即使得了第一名，麗莎依然很謙虛，還感謝她的隊友。

en: Her modesty about her great talent made everyone like her even more.
zh: 她雖然很有才華卻很謙虛，讓大家更喜歡她了。

en: The nurse used a machine to monitor the patient's heartbeat.
zh: 護理師用儀器監測病人的心跳。

en: Tourists take photos in front of the old stone monument in the square.
zh: 觀光客在廣場上那座古老的石碑前拍照。

en: The café has great desserts; moreover, the prices are very reasonable.
zh: 這家咖啡廳的甜點很棒，此外，價格也很合理。

en: Good grades are not the only thing that motivates students to learn.
zh: 好成績並不是激勵學生學習的唯一因素。

en: Lisa's main motivation for studying English is to travel the world.
zh: 麗莎學英文的主要動機是想環遊世界。

en: Much of Taiwan is mountainous, so many rivers are short and fast.
zh: 台灣大部分地區多山，所以許多河川又短又急。

en: After the rain, the hiking path was so muddy that our shoes got dirty.
zh: 下過雨後，登山步道非常泥濘，我們的鞋子都弄髒了。

en: On the narrow mountain road, a mule carried our heavy bags.
zh: 在狹窄的山路上，一頭騾子幫我們背著沉重的行李。

en: She checked her answers multiple times before handing in her test.
zh: 她交卷前把答案檢查了好多次。

en: In the mystery novel, the murderer turns out to be the quiet neighbor.
zh: 在這本推理小說裡，兇手原來是那位安靜的鄰居。

en: We heard the soft murmur of voices from the next classroom.
zh: 我們聽見隔壁教室傳來輕柔的低語聲。

en: Amy and Lisa became friends because of their mutual love of music.
zh: 艾咪和麗莎因為都熱愛音樂而成為朋友。

en: A mysterious light appeared in the night sky, and nobody knew what it was.
zh: 夜空中出現一道神祕的光，沒有人知道那是什麼。

en: Only two students got perfect scores on the test, namely Amy and Lisa.
zh: 只有兩位學生考滿分，也就是艾咪和麗莎。

en: Students of many nationalities study together at this international school.
zh: 這所國際學校裡有許多不同國籍的學生一起上課。

en: Our club collects old clothes and gives them to needy families in winter.
zh: 我們社團收集舊衣服，在冬天送給貧困的家庭。

en: Don't neglect your health just because you are busy with schoolwork.
zh: 別因為忙於課業就忽視了自己的健康。

en: Lisa negotiated with her parents for an extra hour of phone time on weekends.
zh: 麗莎和爸媽協商，爭取週末多一小時的手機時間。

en: It was raining heavily; nevertheless, the soccer team kept practicing on the field.
zh: 雨下得很大，然而足球隊仍在球場上繼續練習。

en: After watching a scary movie, the little girl had a terrible nightmare.
zh: 看完恐怖片後，小女孩做了一場可怕的惡夢。

en: Helping others without asking for anything in return is a noble act.
zh: 幫助別人而不求回報，是一種高尚的行為。

en: Everything he said about aliens living in our school was complete nonsense.
zh: 他說外星人住在我們學校的那些話，全是胡說八道。

en: Nowadays, most teenagers use their phones to check the news.
zh: 現今大多數青少年都用手機看新聞。

en: Some countries use nuclear power plants to produce most of their electricity.
zh: 有些國家用核能電廠來生產大部分的電力。

en: The singer has received numerous messages from fans around the world.
zh: 這位歌手收到了來自世界各地粉絲的大量訊息。

en: Every morning, Mom drops my baby brother off at a nursery near her office.
zh: 每天早上，媽媽都會把我的小弟弟送到她公司附近的托兒所。

en: Mom always packs a nutritious lunch with rice, vegetables, and fish.
zh: 媽媽總是準備有米飯、蔬菜和魚的營養午餐。

en: The dog trainer teaches puppies obedience through games and treats.
zh: 訓犬師透過遊戲和零食教導小狗服從。

en: The obedient puppy sat down as soon as Amy told it to.
zh: 那隻聽話的小狗一聽到艾咪的指令就馬上坐下。

en: Nobody raised any objection to the class plan for the school fair.
zh: 對於班上的園遊會計畫，沒有人提出任何反對意見。

en: The main objective of this lesson is to improve your listening skills.
zh: 這堂課的主要目標是提升你們的聽力技巧。

en: Through careful observation, the students noticed that the plant grew toward the light.
zh: 透過仔細觀察，學生們注意到植物會朝著光的方向生長。

en: Fear of speaking in public is a common obstacle for many students.
zh: 害怕在眾人面前說話，是許多學生常見的障礙。

en: You must obtain permission from your parents before joining the school trip.
zh: 參加校外旅行前，你必須先取得父母的同意。

en: Except for an occasional cloud, the sky was clear all day.
zh: 除了偶爾飄過的雲之外，天空一整天都很晴朗。

en: On the form, please write down your name, age, and occupation.
zh: 請在表格上寫下你的姓名、年齡和職業。

en: Homework and club activities occupy most of Lisa's free time.
zh: 功課和社團活動占據了麗莎大部分的空閒時間。

en: Lisa didn't mean to offend anyone with her joke about the food.
zh: 麗莎開那個食物的玩笑，並不是故意要冒犯任何人。

en: Please take no offense; I just think your plan needs a few changes.
zh: 請別介意，我只是覺得你的計畫需要做些修改。

en: Some messages under her video were so offensive that she removed them.
zh: 她影片下方有些留言太冒犯人，所以她把它們刪掉了。

en: We watched a Taiwanese opera with Grandpa at the temple festival.
zh: 我們在廟會時和爺爺一起看了歌仔戲。

en: Many students oppose the plan to shorten the summer vacation.
zh: 許多學生反對縮短暑假的計畫。

en: If you miss the last bus, taking a taxi is your only option.
zh: 如果你錯過末班公車，搭計程車就是你唯一的選擇。

en: The moon takes about 27 days to orbit the Earth.
zh: 月球繞行地球一圈大約需要27天。

en: Amy has played the violin in the school orchestra since her first year.
zh: 艾咪從一年級起就在學校管弦樂團拉小提琴。

en: All new students must attend orientation on the first day of school.
zh: 所有新生都必須在開學第一天參加新生訓練。

en: The story is about an orphan who grows up in a small village.
zh: 這個故事是關於一個在小村莊長大的孤兒。

en: Take an umbrella; otherwise, you'll get wet on the way home.
zh: 帶把傘吧，否則你回家路上會淋濕。

en: Nobody could guess the outcome of the final game until the last minute.
zh: 直到最後一分鐘，都沒有人猜得到決賽的結果。

en: Lisa received an award for her outstanding performance in the science fair.
zh: 麗莎因為在科展中的傑出表現而獲獎。

en: The birthday cake was oval and covered with fresh strawberries and cream.
zh: 這個生日蛋糕是橢圓形的，上面鋪滿了新鮮草莓和鮮奶油。

en: Grandpa put on his heavy overcoat before going out into the cold wind.
zh: 爺爺穿上厚重的大衣，才走進寒風中。

en: With help from her friends, Amy overcame her fear of public speaking.
zh: 在朋友的幫助下，艾咪克服了上台說話的恐懼。

en: Our hotel room overlooks the beach, so we can watch the sunrise every morning.
zh: 我們的飯店房間可以俯瞰海灘，所以每天早上都能看日出。

en: The singer became famous overnight after her video got millions of views.
zh: 那位歌手的影片獲得數百萬次觀看後，她一夕之間爆紅。

en: In history class, we learned how the people overthrew an unfair king.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到人民如何推翻一位不公正的國王。

en: Plants give off oxygen, which all animals need to breathe.
zh: 植物會釋放氧氣，而所有動物都需要氧氣來呼吸。

en: Run at a steady pace so you don't get tired too soon.
zh: 用穩定的步調跑步，才不會太快就累了。

en: A panel of three teachers chose the best speech of the day.
zh: 由三位老師組成的評審小組選出了當天最佳的演講。

en: The man jumped from the plane, opened his parachute, and landed safely in a field.
zh: 那名男子從飛機上跳下，打開降落傘，安全降落在一片田野上。

en: Each paragraph of your report should start with a clear main idea.
zh: 你報告的每一段都應該以清楚的主旨開頭。

en: The teacher gave me partial credit because my answer was only half right.
zh: 因為我的答案只對了一半，老師給了我部分分數。

en: Active participation in class discussions will help raise your grade.
zh: 積極參與課堂討論有助於提高你的成績。

en: The school formed a partnership with a local farm to provide fresh vegetables.
zh: 學校和當地一座農場建立合作關係，提供新鮮蔬菜。

en: Instead of being passive in class, try to ask questions and share ideas.
zh: 上課時不要太被動，試著發問並分享想法。

en: Lisa cooked pasta with tomato sauce for the whole family tonight.
zh: 麗莎今晚為全家人煮了番茄紅醬義大利麵。

en: The puppy put its dirty paw on my clean white shirt.
zh: 小狗把牠髒髒的爪子放在我乾淨的白襯衫上。

en: There was a peculiar smell in the kitchen, but nobody knew where it came from.
zh: 廚房裡有一股奇怪的味道，但沒人知道是從哪裡來的。

en: The kids peeped through the door to see their birthday surprise.
zh: 孩子們從門縫偷看他們的生日驚喜。

en: Teenagers often feel pressure from their peers to dress or act a certain way.
zh: 青少年常感受到來自同儕的壓力，覺得必須以某種方式穿著或表現。

en: The library charges a small penalty for returning books late.
zh: 圖書館對逾期還書收取少許罰款。

en: About eighty percent of the students in our class walk to school.
zh: 我們班大約百分之八十的學生走路上學。

en: A large percentage of teenagers spend over three hours a day on their phones.
zh: 很高比例的青少年每天花超過三小時在手機上。

en: Don't wait for perfection; just do your best and keep improving.
zh: 不要等到完美才行動，盡力而為並持續進步就好。

en: Amy's mom wears a light perfume that smells like roses.
zh: 艾咪的媽媽擦著一款聞起來像玫瑰的淡香水。

en: Lisa hopes to find a permanent home for the cat she found on the street.
zh: 麗莎希望替她在街上撿到的貓找到一個永久的家。

en: After much persuasion, Dad finally agreed to let us get a puppy.
zh: 經過一番說服，爸爸終於答應讓我們養小狗。

en: Amy gave a persuasive speech about why students need more sleep.
zh: 艾咪發表了一場很有說服力的演講，談學生為什麼需要更多睡眠。

en: Don't be so pessimistic; you still have a week to prepare for the exam.
zh: 別這麼悲觀，你還有一個星期可以準備考試。

en: Farmers have to protect their crops from pests such as insects and mice.
zh: 農夫必須保護作物，免受昆蟲和老鼠等害蟲侵害。

en: A rainbow is a natural phenomenon that happens when sunlight passes through raindrops.
zh: 彩虹是陽光穿過雨滴時產生的一種自然現象。

en: The Greek philosopher believed that knowing yourself is the start of wisdom.
zh: 那位希臘哲學家認為，認識自己是智慧的開端。

en: Late at night, our talk turned philosophical as we wondered about the meaning of life.
zh: 夜深時，我們的談話變得很有哲學味，開始思考人生的意義。

en: Lisa wants to study philosophy in college because she loves asking big questions.
zh: 麗莎想在大學念哲學，因為她喜歡思考重大的問題。

en: Amy joined the photography club to learn how to take better pictures.
zh: 艾咪加入攝影社，學習如何拍出更好的照片。

en: Regular exercise is good for both your physical and mental health.
zh: 規律運動對身體和心理健康都有好處。

en: If the cough lasts more than a week, you should see a physician.
zh: 如果咳嗽持續超過一週，你應該去看醫生。

en: The physicist explained how light travels in a way that everyone could understand.
zh: 那位物理學家用大家都聽得懂的方式解釋光如何傳播。

en: Physics is Amy's favorite subject because she loves learning how things work.
zh: 物理是艾咪最喜歡的科目，因為她喜歡了解事物運作的原理。

en: Grandma makes her own pickles and serves them with rice for breakfast.
zh: 奶奶自己做醃菜，早餐時配著飯一起吃。

en: She was a pioneer in using the internet to teach students in poor areas.
zh: 她是利用網路教導偏鄉學生的先驅。

en: Fruit is plentiful in summer, so it is also cheaper.
zh: 夏天水果很豐富，所以價格也比較便宜。

en: The plot of the movie was so exciting that nobody looked at their phones.
zh: 這部電影的情節太精彩了，沒有人去看手機。

en: We picked fresh plums from the tree and made them into sweet jam.
zh: 我們從樹上摘了新鮮的李子，做成香甜的果醬。

en: We called a plumber because the kitchen sink was leaking.
zh: 因為廚房水槽漏水，我們找了水電工來修。

en: Some mushrooms in the forest are poisonous, so never pick and eat them.
zh: 森林裡有些蘑菇有毒，所以千萬不要摘來吃。

en: Dad polishes his shoes every Sunday night before the busy week starts.
zh: 爸爸每個星期天晚上都會擦亮皮鞋，迎接忙碌的一週。

en: The popularity of bubble tea has spread from Taiwan to many other countries.
zh: 珍珠奶茶的高人氣已從台灣擴散到許多其他國家。

en: This portable speaker is small enough to fit in your backpack.
zh: 這台可攜式喇叭小到可以放進你的背包。

en: The movie portrays the life of a young girl growing up in the countryside.
zh: 這部電影描繪一個在鄉下長大的小女孩的生活。

en: Lisa possesses a rare talent for singing and playing the piano.
zh: 麗莎擁有唱歌和彈鋼琴的罕見天分。

en: For many teenagers, a phone is their most valuable possession.
zh: 對許多青少年來說，手機是他們最寶貴的財物。

en: The postage for sending this postcard to Japan is twenty dollars.
zh: 寄這張明信片到日本的郵資是二十元。

en: With hard work, every student has the potential to do great things.
zh: 只要努力，每個學生都有成就大事的潛力。

en: Lisa's directions were so precise that we found the small café without any trouble.
zh: 麗莎的指示非常精確，所以我們毫不費力就找到了那間小咖啡店。

en: Scientists predict that heavy rain will fall in northern Taiwan this weekend.
zh: 科學家預測這個週末北台灣會下大雨。

en: Her prediction came true: our class won first prize in the school singing event.
zh: 她的預測成真了：我們班在學校歌唱活動中得到第一名。

en: During her pregnancy, our English teacher still came to school every day with a smile.
zh: 懷孕期間，我們的英文老師仍然每天面帶微笑來學校。

en: Mrs. Lin is pregnant, so her students take turns carrying her heavy books upstairs.
zh: 林老師懷孕了，所以她的學生輪流幫她把重重的書搬上樓。

en: Amy felt nervous before giving a presentation about ocean plastic to the whole class.
zh: 艾咪在向全班報告海洋塑膠問題之前感到很緊張。

en: The museum works on the preservation of old photos and letters from the city's past.
zh: 這間博物館致力於保存這座城市過去的老照片和信件。

en: Local people are working hard to preserve the old trees in the village.
zh: 當地居民正努力保護村子裡的老樹。

en: The school nurse taught us that washing hands often is the key to cold prevention.
zh: 學校護理師告訴我們，勤洗手是預防感冒的關鍵。

en: Safety is our prime concern when the club goes hiking in the mountains.
zh: 社團去山上健行時，安全是我們的首要考量。

en: In history class, we learned how primitive people made tools from stone.
zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到原始人如何用石頭製作工具。

en: For most third-year students, studying for the big exam is their top priority now.
zh: 對大多數高三學生來說，準備大考是他們現在的首要之務。

en: Please don't post photos of your friends online without asking; respect their privacy.
zh: 請不要未經詢問就把朋友的照片貼到網路上；要尊重他們的隱私。

en: At this school, only club leaders have the privilege of using the music room after class.
zh: 在這所學校，只有社長享有放學後使用音樂教室的特權。

en: Before the experiment, the teacher explained the safety procedure step by step.
zh: 實驗開始前，老師一步一步說明安全程序。

en: After a short break, the speaker proceeded with her talk about saving water.
zh: 短暫休息後，講者繼續進行她關於節約用水的演講。

en: Lisa had a productive afternoon and finished all her homework before dinner.
zh: 麗莎度過了很有生產力的下午，晚餐前就寫完了所有作業。

en: Teaching is a profession that requires a lot of patience and love.
zh: 教書是一個需要很多耐心和愛心的職業。

en: Our class hired a professional photographer to take pictures on the last day of school.
zh: 我們班請了一位專業攝影師在學期最後一天拍照。

en: The students' bubble tea stand at the school fair was surprisingly profitable.
zh: 學生們在園遊會擺的珍珠奶茶攤出乎意料地賺錢。

en: A prominent scientist visited our school to talk about the future of clean energy.
zh: 一位知名的科學家來我們學校談論潔淨能源的未來。

en: The coach thinks Amy is a promising young swimmer with a bright future.
zh: 教練認為艾美是一位很有前途、未來一片光明的年輕泳將。

en: My aunt got a promotion at work, so we celebrated with a big dinner.
zh: 我阿姨工作升遷了，所以我們吃了一頓大餐慶祝。

en: The news about plastic in the ocean prompted our class to stop using straws.
zh: 海洋塑膠的新聞促使我們班不再使用吸管。

en: Our English teacher helps us improve our pronunciation by reading aloud every morning.
zh: 我們的英文老師藉由每天早上朗讀來幫助我們改善發音。

en: The principal accepted Amy's proposal to put more trash cans around the school.
zh: 校長接受了艾美在校園裡多放幾個垃圾桶的提議。

en: Small shops in the old town began to prosper as more tourists came to visit.
zh: 隨著越來越多觀光客造訪，老街上的小店開始興盛起來。

en: The new highway brought jobs and prosperity to the quiet fishing town.
zh: 新的公路為這個寧靜的漁村小鎮帶來了工作機會與繁榮。

en: Thanks to hard work, the village became a prosperous place full of tea farms.
zh: 由於大家辛勤工作，這座村莊變成一個遍布茶園的繁榮地方。

en: Eggs, milk, and beans are good sources of protein for growing teenagers.
zh: 蛋、牛奶和豆類是發育中青少年很好的蛋白質來源。

en: Many students wrote letters to protest against the plan to cut down the old trees.
zh: 許多學生寫信抗議砍伐老樹的計畫。

en: Too much pressure from exams can cause psychological problems for some students.
zh: 過大的考試壓力可能會讓一些學生產生心理問題。

en: The school psychologist gives students advice on how to deal with stress.
zh: 學校的心理師給學生如何應付壓力的建議。
