en: Lisa wants to study psychology in college because she likes helping people.
zh: 麗莎想在大學念心理學，因為她喜歡幫助別人。

en: The club celebrated the publication of its first school magazine last Friday.
zh: 社團上週五慶祝第一本校刊的出版。

en: The bake sale got a lot of publicity after students shared it on social media.
zh: 學生在社群媒體上分享後，這場烘焙義賣獲得了很多宣傳。

en: Her short story was published in the school magazine last month.
zh: 她的短篇故事上個月刊登在校刊上。

en: The publisher plans to print more copies of the popular comic book.
zh: 這家出版社打算加印這本熱門漫畫。

en: After high school, Amy plans to pursue her dream of becoming a doctor.
zh: 高中畢業後，艾美打算追求成為醫生的夢想。

en: In pursuit of better grades, Lisa joined a study group at the library.
zh: 為了追求更好的成績，麗莎加入了圖書館的讀書會。

en: The two sisters had a quarrel over who should wash the dishes.
zh: 這兩姊妹為了誰該洗碗而吵架。

en: Grandma made a warm quilt for me from old pieces of cloth.
zh: 奶奶用舊布為我做了一條溫暖的被子。

en: Our teacher began the class with a quotation from a famous writer.
zh: 老師以一句知名作家的名言開始上課。

en: The weather station uses radar to follow the path of the typhoon.
zh: 氣象站利用雷達追蹤颱風的路徑。

en: Ben flew into a rage when his little brother broke his new phone.
zh: 弟弟弄壞了班的新手機時，班勃然大怒。

en: Northern Taiwan usually gets heavy rainfall in summer when typhoons arrive.
zh: 夏天颱風來臨時，北台灣通常會有大量降雨。

en: Mom added some raisins to the bread to make it sweeter.
zh: 媽媽在麵包裡加了一些葡萄乾，讓它更甜。

en: Set realistic goals, like reading ten pages a day, instead of a whole book at once.
zh: 設定實際的目標，例如一天讀十頁，而不是一次讀完整本書。

en: Some teenagers rebel against their parents' rules by staying out late at night.
zh: 有些青少年會用晚歸來反抗父母的規定。

en: Amy couldn't recall where she had put her student card that morning.
zh: 艾美想不起來那天早上把學生證放在哪裡了。

en: The school held a small reception to welcome the exchange students from Japan.
zh: 學校舉辦了一場小型歡迎會，迎接來自日本的交換學生。

en: Jenny's father shared his secret recipe for beef noodle soup with the cooking club.
zh: 珍妮的爸爸和烹飪社分享了他的牛肉麵祕傳食譜。

en: Ben's hard work at the hospital finally won recognition from the city government.
zh: 班在醫院的辛勤付出終於獲得市政府的肯定。

en: After breaking her leg, Amy made a full recovery and joined the team again.
zh: 腿骨折之後，艾美完全康復並重新歸隊。

en: The park offers many kinds of recreation, such as biking, fishing, and camping.
zh: 這座公園提供許多種休閒活動，例如騎單車、釣魚和露營。

en: Our class recycles paper, bottles, and cans to help protect the environment.
zh: 我們班回收紙類、瓶子和鋁罐，幫忙保護環境。

en: The shop offers a price reduction to students who show their school ID.
zh: 這家店為出示學生證的學生提供降價優惠。

en: Please refer to page twenty of your book for more examples.
zh: 更多例子請參考你課本的第二十頁。

en: You may use a dictionary for reference when you write your English report.
zh: 寫英文報告時，你可以用字典作為參考。

en: The calm lake reflected the mountains and the blue sky like a mirror.
zh: 平靜的湖面像鏡子一樣倒映著群山和藍天。

en: Amy looked at her reflection in the window before walking into the interview.
zh: 走進面試會場前，艾美看了看自己在窗戶上的倒影。

en: The school plans a reform of its lunch menu to offer healthier food.
zh: 學校計畫改革午餐菜單，提供更健康的食物。

en: Our club collected warm clothes for refugee families who had lost their homes.
zh: 我們社團為失去家園的難民家庭募集保暖衣物。

en: The shoes were too small, so Lisa took them back and asked for a refund.
zh: 鞋子太小了，所以麗莎把它們拿回店裡要求退款。

en: Her polite refusal of the extra dessert surprised everyone at the table.
zh: 她禮貌地拒絕了多出來的甜點，讓同桌的人都很驚訝。

en: The principal sent parents a letter regarding the new school bus schedule.
zh: 校長寄給家長一封關於新校車時刻表的信。

en: Students must register for the summer camp before the end of May.
zh: 學生必須在五月底前報名夏令營。

en: Online registration for the English speech event closes at midnight this Friday.
zh: 英文演講活動的線上報名將在本週五午夜截止。

en: Our bodies sweat to help regulate temperature on hot summer days.
zh: 在炎熱的夏日，我們的身體會流汗來幫助調節體溫。

en: According to school regulations, students may not use phones during class.
zh: 根據校規，學生上課時不得使用手機。

en: After her first rejection from the art school, Lisa practiced even harder.
zh: 第一次被美術學校拒絕後，麗莎練習得更加努力。

en: For relaxation, Amy listens to soft music after a long day at school.
zh: 為了放鬆，艾美在學校忙了一整天後會聽輕柔的音樂。

en: Please only include information that is relevant to the topic of your report.
zh: 請只放入與你報告主題相關的資料。

en: A cup of warm honey water can help relieve a sore throat.
zh: 一杯溫蜂蜜水能幫助舒緩喉嚨痛。

en: Tom was reluctant to leave his warm bed on the cold winter morning.
zh: 在寒冷的冬天早晨，湯姆很不情願離開溫暖的被窩。

en: Her kind remark about my drawing made me feel much more confident.
zh: 她對我的畫作的友善評論讓我更有自信了。

en: The team made remarkable progress and won second place in the national science fair.
zh: 這支隊伍進步非凡，在全國科展中得到第二名。

en: Hot chicken soup is Grandma's favorite home remedy for a bad cold.
zh: 熱雞湯是奶奶最愛用來治重感冒的居家療法。

en: Lisa went to the library to renew the books she had borrowed.
zh: 麗莎去圖書館續借她之前借的書。

en: Learning new words takes a lot of repetition, so review them every day.
zh: 學新單字需要大量的重複練習，所以要每天複習。

en: The painting is a beautiful representation of life in a small fishing village.
zh: 這幅畫美麗地呈現了小漁村的生活。

en: This night market has a reputation for delicious and cheap street food.
zh: 這座夜市以美味又便宜的小吃聞名。

en: Firefighters came quickly to rescue a cat stuck at the top of a tree.
zh: 消防員很快就趕來救援一隻困在樹頂的貓。

en: Our group did research on how plastic affects sea animals for the science fair.
zh: 我們這組為了科展研究塑膠如何影響海洋動物。

en: Researchers found that teenagers who sleep less often feel tired in class.
zh: 研究人員發現，睡眠較少的青少年上課時常覺得疲倦。

en: Amy closely resembles her mother; they both have big eyes and long hair.
zh: 艾美長得很像她媽媽；她們都有大眼睛和長頭髮。

en: We made a reservation at the hot pot restaurant for eight people on Saturday.
zh: 我們在火鍋店訂了星期六八個人的位子。

en: Mr. Chen decided to resign from his job to open a small café.
zh: 陳先生決定辭去工作，開一家小咖啡店。

en: The club leader handed in her resignation because she needed more time to study.
zh: 社長遞出辭呈，因為她需要更多時間讀書。

en: Regular exercise and enough sleep can build up your body's resistance to colds.
zh: 規律運動和充足睡眠可以增強身體對感冒的抵抗力。

en: My New Year's resolution is to read one English book every month.
zh: 我的新年新希望是每個月讀一本英文書。

en: The two friends sat down and talked calmly to resolve their problem.
zh: 這兩個朋友坐下來冷靜交談，解決了他們之間的問題。

en: Grandpa believes that any honest job is a respectable way to make a living.
zh: 爺爺相信任何正當的工作都是值得尊敬的謀生方式。

en: Students should be respectful to older people and offer them seats on the bus.
zh: 學生應該尊重長者，並在公車上讓座給他們。

en: Workers spent two years restoring the old temple to its original beauty.
zh: 工人們花了兩年把這座古廟修復回原本的美麗樣貌。

en: There is an age restriction on this ride, so young children cannot get on.
zh: 這項遊樂設施有年齡限制，所以年幼的孩子不能搭乘。

en: This special cup can retain the heat of your coffee for hours.
zh: 這種特殊的杯子能讓你的咖啡保溫好幾個小時。

en: After teaching for thirty years, Mr. Wang will retire next summer.
zh: 教了三十年書之後，王老師將在明年夏天退休。

en: When the rain grew heavier, the climbers decided to retreat down the mountain.
zh: 雨越下越大時，登山客決定撤退下山。

en: Our whole family gets together for a reunion dinner on Chinese New Year's Eve.
zh: 除夕夜時，我們全家人會聚在一起吃團圓飯。

en: In the novel, the main character finally gives up revenge and forgives his enemy.
zh: 在這本小說裡，主角最後放棄報仇，原諒了他的敵人。

en: Please revise your report and hand it in again next Monday.
zh: 請修改你的報告，下週一再交一次。

en: After a few revisions, Lisa's speech became shorter and much clearer.
zh: 經過幾次修訂，麗莎的演講稿變得更簡短、更清楚。

en: The smartphone brought a revolution in the way people talk and share news.
zh: 智慧型手機為人們溝通與分享消息的方式帶來了一場革命。

en: This revolutionary new phone can charge fully in just five minutes.
zh: 這款革命性的新手機只要五分鐘就能完全充飽電。

en: As a reward for passing the exam, Dad took me to a nice restaurant.
zh: 為了獎勵我通過考試，爸爸帶我去一家不錯的餐廳。

en: In this poem, the last words of every two lines rhyme with each other.
zh: 在這首詩中，每兩行的最後一個字互相押韻。

en: The dancers in our school club moved perfectly to the rhythm of the drums.
zh: 我們學校社團的舞者隨著鼓聲的節奏完美地舞動。

en: Can anyone solve this riddle: what has keys but cannot open doors?
zh: 有人能解開這個謎語嗎：什麼東西有「鍵」卻打不開門？

en: The police caught the robber just a few hours after he took the money.
zh: 搶匪搶走錢之後才幾個小時，警方就抓到了他。

en: Mom loves watching old romance movies on Sunday afternoons with a cup of tea.
zh: 媽媽喜歡在週日下午配一杯茶看老式的愛情電影。

en: The bus route to our school changed this week because of road work near the station.
zh: 因為車站附近道路施工，到我們學校的公車路線這週改了。

en: The sudden heavy rain ruined our class picnic in the park on Saturday.
zh: 突如其來的大雨毀了我們班星期六在公園的野餐。

en: Many young people leave rural areas to find jobs in big cities.
zh: 許多年輕人離開鄉村地區，到大城市找工作。

en: The old bike in the garage was rusty, so we cleaned and painted it.
zh: 車庫裡那輛舊腳踏車生鏽了，所以我們把它清理乾淨並重新上漆。

en: Many parents sacrifice their free time to drive their kids to classes.
zh: 許多父母犧牲自己的空閒時間開車送孩子去上課。

en: Weather satellites send pictures of clouds back to Earth every few minutes.
zh: 氣象衛星每隔幾分鐘就把雲層的照片傳回地球。

en: Lisa smiled with satisfaction when she saw the clean and tidy classroom.
zh: 麗莎看到乾淨整齊的教室時，滿意地笑了。

en: Amy was so nervous that she could scarcely say a word on stage.
zh: 艾美緊張到在台上幾乎說不出一句話。

en: We stopped the car to enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery along the way.
zh: 我們把車停下來，欣賞沿途美麗的山景。

en: Mom scolded my brother for playing video games until two in the morning.
zh: 媽媽責罵我弟弟打電動打到凌晨兩點。

en: Could I have two scoops of chocolate ice cream in a cup, please?
zh: 請給我一杯兩球（兩勺）的巧克力冰淇淋好嗎？

en: The cat left a long scratch on my arm when I tried to pick it up.
zh: 我想把貓抱起來時，牠在我的手臂上留下一道長長的抓痕。

en: The art club made a large sculpture of a whale from old plastic bottles.
zh: 美術社用舊塑膠瓶做了一座巨大的鯨魚雕塑。

en: Keep your passwords secure and never share them with anyone online.
zh: 要確保你的密碼安全，絕不要在網路上告訴任何人。

en: Amy seized the chance to study abroad in Japan for a year.
zh: 艾美抓住了到日本留學一年的機會。

en: The early settlers in this valley built their homes near the river for fresh water.
zh: 這座山谷早期的移民把家建在河邊，以便取得淡水。

en: The severe typhoon closed all schools in Taipei for two days.
zh: 強烈颱風讓台北所有學校停課兩天。

en: My aunt taught me how to sew a button back onto my school shirt.
zh: 我阿姨教我如何把鈕釦縫回我的制服襯衫上。

en: On hot days, we like to eat lunch in the shade of the big tree.
zh: 炎熱的日子裡，我們喜歡在大樹的樹蔭下吃午餐。

en: Let's find a shady spot under the trees for our picnic.
zh: 我們在樹下找個陰涼的地方野餐吧。

en: Cheating on a test is shameful, and it never helps you learn.
zh: 考試作弊是可恥的，而且對學習一點幫助也沒有。

en: Dad shaves every morning in the bathroom before he drives to work.
zh: 爸爸每天早上開車上班前都會在浴室刮鬍子。

en: During the sudden storm, the hikers took shelter in a small cave.
zh: 突如其來的暴風雨中，登山客躲進一個小山洞避雨。

en: Jenny's mother works the night shift at the hospital three days a week.
zh: 珍妮的媽媽每週有三天在醫院值夜班。

en: We spent the whole day sightseeing in Tainan and tasting local snacks.
zh: 我們花了一整天在台南觀光、品嚐當地小吃。

en: The teacher needs a parent's signature on this form before the school trip.
zh: 校外教學前，老師需要家長在這份表格上簽名。

en: Our teacher explained the significance of the Dragon Boat Festival in Chinese culture.
zh: 老師解釋了端午節在華人文化中的重要性。

en: Her sincerity touched everyone when she said sorry to the whole class.
zh: 當她向全班道歉時，她的真誠感動了每一個人。

en: Use "is" after a singular subject, such as "my friend" or "the dog."
zh: 在單數主詞後面要用「is」，例如「my friend」或「the dog」。

en: The old factory site will become a park with trees and a playground.
zh: 舊工廠的所在地將改建成有樹木和遊樂場的公園。

en: Lisa made a quick sketch of her cat sleeping on the sofa.
zh: 麗莎快速畫了一張她的貓在沙發上睡覺的素描。

en: From the top of the skyscraper, we could see the whole city at night.
zh: 從摩天大樓頂端，我們可以看到整座城市的夜景。

en: Amy had a slight fever, so she stayed home and rested.
zh: 艾美有點輕微發燒，所以她待在家裡休息。

en: Our class chose the slogan "Less Plastic, Happier Oceans" for our school poster.
zh: 我們班為我們的學校海報選了「少用塑膠，海洋更快樂」這句標語。

en: Don't touch the socket with wet hands, or you might get hurt.
zh: 不要用濕的手碰插座，否則可能會受傷。

en: The school uses new software to help students practice English speaking.
zh: 學校使用新軟體幫助學生練習英文口說。

en: The new library uses solar energy to provide most of its electricity.
zh: 新圖書館大部分的電力由太陽能提供。

en: Grandpa used a spade to dig holes for the new trees in the garden.
zh: 爺爺用鏟子在花園裡挖洞種新樹。

en: Do you have a spare pen? I forgot to bring mine today.
zh: 你有多的筆嗎？我今天忘了帶。

en: A visit to the science museum sparked Amy's interest in stars and space.
zh: 一趟科學博物館之旅引發了艾美對星星和太空的興趣。

en: In the museum, we saw spears that ancient people used for catching fish.
zh: 在博物館裡，我們看到了古代人用來捕魚的矛。

en: Many species of birds fly to southern Taiwan every winter to escape the cold.
zh: 每年冬天都有許多種鳥類飛到南台灣避寒。

en: For many older people, visiting the temple brings a feeling of spiritual peace.
zh: 對許多長者來說，到廟裡參拜能帶來心靈上的平靜。

en: From the mountaintop, we watched a splendid sunrise over the sea of clouds.
zh: 我們在山頂上看到雲海上壯麗的日出。

en: Let's split the bill for the pizza evenly among the four of us.
zh: 披薩的錢我們四個人平均分攤吧。

en: Sprinkle a little sugar on top of the pancakes before you serve them.
zh: 上桌前，在鬆餅上灑一點糖。

en: Tom stabbed a piece of cake with his fork and put it in his mouth.
zh: 湯姆用叉子刺起一塊蛋糕放進嘴裡。

en: Statistics show that more and more teenagers use their phones right before bed.
zh: 統計數據顯示，越來越多青少年在睡前使用手機。

en: You can check the status of your online order on your phone.
zh: 你可以用手機查詢網購訂單的處理狀態。

en: Cut the stems of the flowers before you put them in water.
zh: 把花插進水裡之前，先修剪花莖。

en: Dad turned on the stereo in the living room and played his favorite old songs.
zh: 爸爸打開客廳的音響，播放他最愛的老歌。

en: Don't be so stingy; just share a few of your cookies with your sister.
zh: 別那麼小氣，分幾片餅乾給你妹妹吧。

en: In winter, many girls wear warm stockings under their school skirts.
zh: 冬天時，許多女生會在制服裙底下穿保暖的長襪。

en: Swimming is a good way to strengthen your heart and lungs.
zh: 游泳是強化心肺功能的好方法。

en: Zebras are easy to recognize because of their black and white stripes.
zh: 斑馬因為黑白相間的條紋而很容易辨認。

en: Our team will strive to do better in next year's basketball game.
zh: 我們隊會努力在明年的籃球比賽中表現得更好。

en: Grandpa had a stroke last year, but he is getting better every day.
zh: 爺爺去年中風，但他一天比一天好轉。

en: The submarine traveled deep under the sea to study strange fish.
zh: 這艘潛水艇深入海底研究奇特的魚類。

en: The family decided to sue the company for selling unsafe toys.
zh: 這家人決定控告那家公司販售不安全的玩具。

en: Thank you for your suggestion; we will add more vegetables to the school lunch.
zh: 謝謝你的建議；我們會在學校午餐裡加更多蔬菜。

en: Please summarize the story in three sentences for tomorrow's class.
zh: 請把這個故事摘要成三個句子，明天上課要用。

en: The surgeon told us that Grandpa's knee would heal in about two months.
zh: 外科醫師告訴我們，爺爺的膝蓋大約兩個月就會痊癒。

en: After knee surgery, the basketball player needed six months to walk normally again.
zh: 膝蓋手術後，這位籃球選手花了六個月才能再正常走路。

en: After an hour of trying to fix the computer, Amy finally surrendered and called her dad.
zh: 試著修電腦一個小時後，艾美終於投降，打電話給爸爸。

en: It took the new student a few weeks to get used to her new surroundings.
zh: 這位新同學花了幾個星期才適應新環境。

en: Don't open suspicious emails or messages from people you don't know.
zh: 不要打開陌生人寄來的可疑電子郵件或訊息。

en: The tall grass swayed gently in the wind along the river.
zh: 河邊的高草隨風輕輕搖曳。

en: The word "banana" has three syllables, and the stress is on the second one.
zh: 「banana」這個字有三個音節，重音在第二個音節。

en: Our teacher was very sympathetic when Amy told her that her grandmother was sick.
zh: 艾美告訴老師她奶奶生病時，老師非常同情她。

en: Lisa felt deep sympathy for the animals that lost their homes in the forest fire.
zh: 麗莎對在森林大火中失去家園的動物深感同情。

en: Making a study plan is a systematic way to prepare for exams.
zh: 擬定讀書計畫是準備考試的一種有系統的方法。

en: A technician came to fix the broken air conditioner in our classroom.
zh: 一位技術人員來修理我們教室壞掉的冷氣。

en: Technological changes have made it easier for students to learn online.
zh: 科技的變化讓學生在網路上學習變得更容易。

en: Long ago, people used the telegraph to send short messages over long distances.
zh: 很久以前，人們用電報遠距離傳送簡短的訊息。

en: At the science camp, we looked at the moon through a large telescope.
zh: 在科學營，我們透過一架大型望遠鏡觀察月亮。

en: Lisa has a tendency to stay up too late when exams are coming.
zh: 考試快到時，麗莎有熬夜太晚的傾向。

en: The room was quiet and tense as students waited for their test results.
zh: 學生等待考試成績時，教室裡安靜又緊張。

en: A funny joke from the teacher helped ease the tension before the exam.
zh: 老師的一個笑話幫忙緩和了考前的緊張氣氛。

en: The little girl screamed in terror when she saw a big spider on the wall.
zh: 小女孩看到牆上的大蜘蛛時，嚇得尖叫。

en: The theme of this year's school fair is protecting the earth and saving energy.
zh: 今年園遊會的主題是保護地球和節約能源。

en: Before the guests arrived, we gave the house a thorough cleaning.
zh: 客人到之前，我們把房子徹底打掃了一遍。

en: It was very thoughtful of Amy to bring soup to her sick friend.
zh: 艾美帶湯給生病的朋友，真是非常體貼。

en: The baby laughed loudly when his big sister tickled his feet.
zh: 姊姊搔寶寶的腳底時，寶寶咯咯大笑。

en: Please check the train timetable so we don't miss the last train home.
zh: 請查一下火車時刻表，我們才不會錯過回家的末班車。

en: The timid girl was too shy to raise her hand in class.
zh: 那個膽小的女孩太害羞了，不敢在課堂上舉手。

en: The heat was tolerable because a cool wind kept blowing from the sea.
zh: 因為一直有涼風從海上吹來，這種熱還可以忍受。

en: Working in a team teaches us tolerance for people with different ideas.
zh: 團隊合作教會我們包容想法不同的人。

en: Our teacher is tolerant of mistakes and encourages us to keep trying.
zh: 我們老師對錯誤很寬容，並鼓勵我們繼續嘗試。

en: Mr. Lin will not tolerate students using phones during his class.
zh: 林老師不容許學生在他的課堂上使用手機。

en: On Tomb Sweeping Day, our family visits our grandfather's tomb in the hills.
zh: 清明節時，我們全家會到山上去掃祖父的墓。

en: In the famous story, the slow tortoise wins the race against the fast rabbit.
zh: 在那個有名的故事裡，慢吞吞的烏龜贏了跑得快的兔子。

en: Waiting a whole week for the test results felt like torture to Amy.
zh: 等一整個星期的考試成績，對艾美來說簡直是折磨。

en: The flood was a tragedy for the farmers who lost all their crops.
zh: 這場水災對失去所有作物的農民來說是一場悲劇。

en: The movie had a tragic ending, and many people in the theater cried.
zh: 這部電影的結局很悲慘，戲院裡很多人都哭了。

en: Lisa will transfer to a new school after her family moves to the south.
zh: 麗莎家搬到南部後，她將轉學到一所新學校。

en: The students transformed an empty classroom into a bright and warm reading room.
zh: 學生們把一間空教室改造成明亮溫馨的閱讀室。

en: Can you help me translate this Japanese menu into Chinese?
zh: 你能幫我把這份日文菜單翻譯成中文嗎？

en: This English translation of the Chinese poem keeps its original beauty.
zh: 這首中文詩的英文翻譯保留了原詩的美感。

en: Amy wants to become a translator because she loves learning foreign languages.
zh: 艾美想當譯者，因為她很喜歡學外語。

en: Public transportation in Taipei is fast, clean, and easy to use.
zh: 台北的大眾運輸快速、乾淨，又方便使用。

en: Amy's hands trembled as she stood up to give her first speech.
zh: 艾美站起來發表她的第一次演講時，雙手發抖。

en: Learning a new language takes a tremendous amount of time and effort.
zh: 學一種新語言需要投入大量的時間和心力。

en: The museum shows tribal clothing from different groups of Taiwan's native people.
zh: 這間博物館展示台灣各原住民族的部落服飾。

en: The team returned to school in triumph after winning the national high school basketball title.
zh: 這支隊伍贏得全國高中籃球冠軍後，凱旋回到學校。

en: The printer is troublesome; it stops working whenever we need it most.
zh: 這台印表機真麻煩，每次我們最需要它的時候就故障。

en: The little boy tumbled down the stairs, but luckily he wasn't hurt.
zh: 小男孩從樓梯上跌了下來，但幸好沒有受傷。

en: The birds used small twigs and leaves to build a nest in the tree.
zh: 鳥兒用小樹枝和樹葉在樹上築巢。

en: Music is a universal language that people all over the world can understand.
zh: 音樂是全世界的人都能理解的共通語言。

en: The doctor urged Dad to eat less sugar and exercise more often.
zh: 醫生力勸爸爸少吃糖、多運動。

en: Please call me back as soon as possible; it's an urgent matter.
zh: 請盡快回電給我，這是件緊急的事。

en: Our teacher showed us the correct usage of "make" and "do" in English.
zh: 老師教我們英文中「make」和「do」的正確用法。

en: The hotel had no vacancy, so we had to find another place to stay.
zh: 這家旅館沒有空房，所以我們只好另找住宿的地方。

en: We looked everywhere for Amy's lost key, but our search was in vain.
zh: 我們到處找艾美弄丟的鑰匙，但都白費力氣。

en: The vast ocean stretched as far as the eye could see.
zh: 廣闊的海洋一望無際。

en: Lisa is a vegetarian, so she ordered the tofu noodles instead of beef.
zh: 麗莎吃素，所以她點了豆腐麵而不是牛肉麵。

en: A fishing vessel returned to the harbor early because of the coming storm.
zh: 一艘漁船因為暴風雨即將來臨而提早返港。

en: Students who violate the school rules will have to clean the classroom.
zh: 違反校規的學生得打掃教室。

en: Parking in front of the fire station is a violation of traffic rules.
zh: 在消防隊門口停車違反交通規則。

en: Patience is a virtue, especially when you are waiting in a long line.
zh: 耐心是一種美德，尤其是在排長長的隊伍時。

en: The flu virus spreads easily in crowded places, so wash your hands often.
zh: 流感病毒在擁擠的地方很容易傳播，所以要常洗手。

en: Pictures and videos are visual aids that help students remember new words easily.
zh: 圖片和影片是幫助學生輕鬆記住新單字的視覺輔助工具。

en: Getting enough sleep is vital for teenagers' health and learning.
zh: 充足的睡眠對青少年的健康和學習至關重要。

en: Joining the beach cleaning activity is voluntary, but most of our class signed up.
zh: 參加淨灘活動是自願的，但我們班大部分人都報名了。

en: Every Saturday, Amy works as a volunteer at the city library.
zh: 每週六，艾美都在市立圖書館當志工。

en: The ship's first voyage across the Pacific Ocean took about three weeks.
zh: 這艘船首次橫越太平洋的航行花了大約三週。

en: The sound of birds singing wakened me early on Sunday morning.
zh: 星期天一大早，鳥鳴聲就把我喚醒了。

en: You can find the summer camp schedule on our school's website.
zh: 你可以在我們學校的網站上找到夏令營的時間表。

en: The club raises money for the welfare of homeless dogs and cats.
zh: 這個社團為流浪貓狗的福利募款。

en: Dad gave me a wink to let me know that Mom's birthday party was a secret.
zh: 爸爸對我眨眼示意，讓我知道媽媽的生日派對是個祕密。

en: Lisa's quick wit always makes everyone laugh during our long class meetings.
zh: 麗莎的機智總是讓大家在冗長的班會中笑出來。

en: In the story, the old witch turned the prince into a frog.
zh: 在故事裡，老女巫把王子變成了一隻青蛙。

en: Lisa had to withdraw from the race because she hurt her foot.
zh: 麗莎因為腳受傷，不得不退出比賽。

en: A witness told the police that the thief ran toward the park.
zh: 一位目擊者告訴警方，小偷往公園的方向跑了。

en: Amy does a short workout every morning to stay healthy and strong.
zh: 艾美每天早上做簡短的健身運動，以保持健康強壯。

en: A friendly workplace makes workers feel happy and work harder.
zh: 友善的工作場所讓員工感到快樂，也更加努力工作。

en: Divers found the wreck of an old ship at the bottom of the sea.
zh: 潛水員在海底發現了一艘古老船隻的殘骸。

en: Ben couldn't stop yawning in class after staying up late to play games.
zh: 班熬夜打電動之後，上課時一直打呵欠。

en: Grandma still looks youthful because she dances in the park every morning.
zh: 奶奶看起來仍然很年輕，因為她每天早上都在公園跳舞。
